Friend,

There is nothing American about promoting these policies that have failed all over the world. This ideology didn't go so well for the Soviet Union, did it?

I came to this country to escape this destructive vision, and it is disappointing that it has infiltrated the America we know and love.

If we don't fight back against Ilhan Omar and the SQUAD, our country will never get back on track.

Peter,

The rights of LGBTQ+ Americans are under _direct_ attack by elected officials whose sworn duty it is to protect them. Transphobic legislation in particular is on the rise, and EMILYs List women are fighting to stop this hateful movement in its tracks.

This is about so much more than Pride Month — this is about our ability to embrace our truest selves and live safely and freely when we do.

Protecting the LGBTQ+ community starts with electing more LGBTQ+ and allied candidates to higher office. It's that simple.

**[If you're ready to step up for LGBTQ+ candidates and communities, donate now.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/87291043/480659862/-299692699?sourceid=1054072&refcode=WTEFER46_20240620_PrideKP_ND_v1s4&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMGUwM2IwMC02MTJmLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=a8iQLIgqkVpVdSxYEgf9ryGIsY1R_Veze9LEJBdYSB4=)**

EMILYs List-endorsed women have broken barriers and made history, but they didn't achieve any of those landmarks alone. They got to where they are through the consistent and dedicated support of this community and the communities around them.

Every candidate listed above is up for election or reelection this year, and each of them faces unique scrutiny and opposition because of who they are. LGBTQ+ candidates need our help more than ever, and we have to get to work NOW.

Team, we sent this email a few days ago and wanted to bump it for you.

* Create economic opportunity with the lowest unemployment rate ever
* Prioritize public safety in our communities by addressing gun violence
* Fight for Pennsylvania’s youth with the largest year-to-year investment in public education, and universal school breakfast for all K-12 students

In a moment, I’m going to ask you to **[chip in to help me meet my weekly fundraising goal](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87292692/480679856/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1385-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTVlMDc3MTMtNjYyZi1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=6ZeTiPUkmN4sVD0-cHkuG9drQvVgj-d9Ssre_oCPItU=)** , but before I do that, I want to give you an update on where things stand right now.

And now, thanks to this feature, people all around the world know it, too: **that I've got what it takes to defeat Rick Scott**.
This is a major win for us, friend, especially as we near Election Day. Make no mistake: Reproductive rights _will_ be on the ballot this November. As an immigrant, wife, mother, and caretaker, I know firsthand how difficult it can be for working families to get by. name: Christa Kinsley
subject: Mario for Congress: Final Stretch to June 25!
body:
Dear Friends and Supporters of Mario,

It's almost time! This _Tuesday, June 25 is Primary Election Day_!

The response to our campaign from around District 24 has been incredible. From the base of ground support that has greeted us in each county, people already familiar with Mario and his positions, and voters who got a taste of what "representation" by Claudia Tenney looks like the past couple years, the voters of District 24 are eager and clamoring for a Representative in Congress like Mario Fratto.

Though we feel Mario's position is very strong in this election, you probably have been receiving the flood of ads from Claudia full of reprehensible lies about Mario. She is not willing to run _on_ her record, so she's running _from_ her record, taking to name-calling and hiding behind Trump as her only means to win.

Many people are seeing through this and disgusted by these tactics. But there are others who may not know as much about the candidates who are being deceived, which is exactly what she intends to do.

**We need your help** to bridge the gap for those voters who are sorting through their stack of mail, wondering what is true. One of Mario's strengths has always been that he is relational, willing to have conversations, focusing on the importance of family, community, talking with one another, working together to protect the heritage that was passed down to us. That's what a true grassroots campaign is all about - neighbors talking to neighbors. It's harder work than Claudia's method of just dumping in tons of corporate PAC money! [Did you see it was reported we are being outspent 18 to 1?!]

But what we are doing is real - real people having real conversations translates to _real_ votes. And based on Claudia's recent desperate and unhinged campaign ads, clearly what we are doing is working - and she is _scared_!

**We need to finish strong and be sure all of our supporters get out to vote on June 25!**
**
**
How can you help? **_Make your own personal Get Out The Vote plan and goals for the remaining days we have!_**
**_
_**
* Plan to walk a certain number of streets or minutes each day, deliver door hangers and talk to your neighbors. Drive to the next town over and do the same there.
* Call other people you know in District 24, be sure they know about the Primary and plan to vote for Mario.
* Get call lists from us and plan to call a certain number of voters in the District each day.
* Go to Mario's social media pages, like and share his information.
* Grab a couple friends and yard signs, go to your town's busiest intersection and wave signs on Election Day to spread the excitement and remind others to vote for Mario!

And don't forget - we still have **[eight town hall events](https://marioforcongress.com/meet-mario-second-half-of-june-town-hall-events/ "https://marioforcongress.com/meet-mario-second-half-of-june-town-hall-events/")** all around the district over the next four days! Find the event nearest you and share with your friends who may want to hear Mario and get more information.
Also _Early Voting_ is still taking place through Sunday.

Thank you again for your support. Let us know if we can get materials to you to hand out to voters. With your help in these final days, we are going to send Mario Fratto to Congress for District 24!

Best regards,
Christa Kinsley
Field Director
Phone or text 315-399-7313

name: Hillsdale College via American Action News
subject: Before they're gone
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdf51jun834bgmn9huphafi80usq03s0dnbiple8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30sjhm2p33chh2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zi7tqad0400pjdtiql72lsj7vu3trb9d09qvitk8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30sjhm2p33chh2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“The Second World Wars”** on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zclqq3373p2tacr12cjugpk1fkbl19t70o2ck5ng_rp22sh2s8i6ep30sjhm2p33chh2bs)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,
Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College
P.S. The **“The Second World Wars”** DVD set is great as a homeschool curriculum or for independent study. Plus, it makes a perfect gift for anyone who wants to know more about the Second World War. **[Reserve your copy now.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z9hv10car0lei3s6r69cthrt9tadmf8vle73dc2o_rp22sh2s8i6ep30sjhm2p33chh2bs)**

name: Center for American Liberty
subject: They want you to forget this
body:
Thousands of hardworking, competent people were fired –– all because they refused to get the Covid shot.

| |
---
| | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z8c553f8si9cmj6p4lnskmkivvble30478ck9kc8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30sjhm2p30sdh2bs)
---
Fellow American, You have an opportunity to help correct one of the worst injustices of the Covid era. **Thou****sands of hardworking, competent people were fired –– all because they refused to get the Covid shot.** Doctors, nurses, teachers, members of the military, and many more. It’s the natural tendency of the authoritarian left to punish people for refusing to go along with its schemes. And now that we know more of the truth about Covid, the vaccine, and the shady collusion between government organizations, Big Tech and Big Pharma......they’d love nothing more than to sweep this all under the rug and pretend it never happened. **That’s why I’ve instructed our attorneys at the Center for American Liberty to initiate legal action to hold them accountable.** For starters, we filed a lawsuit against the North Carolina Symphony on behalf of three musicians fired for refusing to get the COVID vaccine._Each of them had been in the Symphony for over a decade._ **[**And if we can win this critical legal battle, we can put employers across the country on notice that they should reinstate victims of their COVID vaccine firings.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zvrep0717t55k2mvasgp5l197l05avoc1u0e09r0_rp22sh2s8i6ep30sjhm2p30sdh2bs)** When the Symphony introduced their vaccine mandate, it offered both religious and medical exemptions.Dovid, Chris, and Rachel each held sincere religious beliefs, filed for exemptions, and expressed a willingness to take other measures—like regular COVID testing—to ensure safety.But the Symphony rejected ALL of them and put them on a year of UNPAID LEAVE.These three musicians were Buddhist, Christian and Jewish. **To you and me, the freedom to practice your religion is a sacred right.****So is your right to bodily autonomy.** But in the eyes of the cultural Marxists who control so many institutions in America today, your body doesn’t belong to you – it belongs to them. They’ll decide where you go... They’ll decide what you need... They’ll decide what you can have... They’ll decide what vaccines you must take...In other words: _Your individual liberties_ will cease to exist.The good news is that while cultural Marxism is popular on college campuses, legacy media press rooms, the boardrooms of woke companies and inside government bureaucracies......the vast majority of Americans are against it. This is a fight we can win – and we must win. **[**You can join me today by making a generous, tax-deductible donation to the Center for American Liberty to fund this lawsuit for medical and religious freedom, and set a precedent nationwide that puts these radicals on notice.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zef7m9pehcppfljbtqsej3easd40cuphhrh4mupo_rp22sh2s8i6ep30sjhm2p30sdh2bs)** Even after the North Carolina Symphony lifted its vaccine mandate, it refused to give these musicians their jobs back.Because it was never about “science” or “health” – it was always about control.And it’s time to tell the cultural Marxists who want to control every aspect of your life that we aren’t backing down.I hope I can count on your support.

Waukesha County

The Republican Party of Waukesha County had a table at Menomonee Falls Memorial Fest on Saturday May 25th. On Memorial Day itself, the county party participated in two parades, in Menomonee Falls and Elm Grove. Waukesha County GOP had a table at the June 8th and 9th Maxwell St. Days Fair in Mukwonago. They hosted an Open House June 13th at our new county party headquarters where hundreds came. Wednesday, June 19th the county party hosted a debate between the 2 Republican candidates running for County District Attorney as part of the Civics Information Initiative.

Taylor County

Parade season underway in Taylor County! Taylor County GOP in Gilman parade on Sunday June 16th.

Sauk County

The Republican party of Sauk County participated in the butter fest parade in Reedsburg Saturday, June 15.

St. Croix County

The Republican Party of St. Croix County has been busy with the United We Stand – 2024 Campaign Kickoff Rally, Roberts Good Neighbor Days Parade, Somerset Pea Soup Days Parade, Baldwin Windmill Days Parade, the monthly Victory Center Prayer Meeting, and the Flag Day Flag Wave in Hudson.

Milwaukee County

The Republican Party of Milwaukee County unveils its Black Republican Coalition during Juneteenth. From the festival to a Q/A Listening Session, Milwaukee continues to make inroads in the community.

Kenosha County

The Republican Party of Kenosha County celebrates Juneteenth, participated in the Kenosha County Dairy Breakfast, and went to the Trump Rally!

Outagamie County

The Republican Party of Outagamie County hosted Poll Observer Training on June 18 and was in the County's Flag Day Parade!

Green County

The Green County Republican Party held their monthly breakfast meeting on June 8th to a capacity crowd with special guest Heather Allen from Wisconsin United for Freedom and Tatiana Bobrowicz, President of the UW Eau Claire College Republicans. It was great to hear their message of hope and freedom as we gain momentum for November!

Wood County

The Republican Party of Wood County held their reorganization meeting on June 17th and now have a new Chairman, Vice-Chairman, and Secretary. The meeting was attended by State Director Leslie Hubert, RPW Chairman Brian Schimming, State Rep. Scott Krug, and State Senator Pat Testin. Shoutout to Floirene Kurtzweil, she is 103 years young and is the oldest living Republican in Wood County!

Dodge County

The Dodge County Republican Party had their breakfast gathering, be sure to catch the next one!

| | Dear Friend,Populism is nothing new to world history. While it can be easy to think about American politics as being divided between the Left and the Right, the reality is much different. What we've really been seeing is two sets of populist backlash against both the Democrat and Republican establishment.
---
| [](http://trk.libertyledger.-Vu3Je9mK2-J_LBXw)
---
| | And believe it or not, these tensions actually trace their roots back to Roman times.

That's why I'm sending you this email today.

I want to make sure you get a free copy of one of our popular eBooks: **[Dueling Populisms by Victor Davis Hanson](http://trk.libertyledger.__2mf4FylQ)**.

Hanson is a Hoover Senior Fellow and world-renowned historian, and I think you'll get a lot out of his insights. Inside this important eBook, you'll learn more about:
* What we can expect from a political climate ruled by movements that rebel against both the establishment--and each other.
* The important parallels between these ancient movements and their modern counterparts in both progressive and conservative populism.
* What lies ahead for America as we revive these ancient tensions in our culture.

You can get your free copy of Dueling Populisms using this secure link: **[https://resources.hoover.org/dueling-populisms-signup/](http://trk.libertyledger.-8A)**.

And please feel free to share this with your family and friends. It's important that we recall the voices of experience and apply them to contemporary conflicts and challenges.

## RFK Jr. Doesn't Qualify For Debate
Independent candidate Robert F. Kennedy Jr. [will not participate](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1uwjAURp8m2Yyurx3bGTx0YaNrx8g_94KLcWhwQbx9BXO379MZjnS-DsshlFra8TNcyHdel5B6udNiBEqBetFj9kyEpEby0ko32wmMHU9eRWvITFHNgCFrPQO56T0wgI1mLB4BNRiUMKNUsLNs1GS1ZkoOJhcHDZRLX7fd91paPxHX53qnbZfWy1j9qffrbVAfA-4H3Idro8fthV5n6yVVGnC_8VmcqTXKT5FaE5li6CR-fkMt_BSZUKUpMjhSiiCzM2pmljJLZo163Hy-Pkqt5WbsoOF4CaW-_f3_GnePfwEAAP__2ltgFA) in next week's presidential debate in Atlanta after failing to meet state ballot and polling benchmarks. CNN, the network hosting the June 27 debate, [required candidates](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DFv8yAQgOFfgzdb3IHBHhg-6ZO3dO1ogTmSS4lJMU2Uf1-1c-d3eKXn_bSePGfez2_-Rq6lsvqt8YNW0yP0qFfdRZeIkFRHDixMsx2lsd3FwaYgQoBAyso0h6ASGpJGp3FOCqljhxK1NAhyRlBysMmo0WqdaJvkOAWhJUVupQ7Xwnu7UMqv8qA6bOXWZXdp7X4I9U_gInDxYdvpeQzn8pMFLqOaBC41ffTX2n9--czp1d8rHRxpb-xzHyn4RgKXo5X6EmrhKNR_AEBrJj111cX7k3Pmw1ih5fnmOf--298SD4ffAQAA__-TTV7N) to have at least four qualifying national polls with at least 15% support and ballot access in enough states to potentially win a majority in the Electoral College--270 electoral votes. Kennedy received at least 15% in [three qualifying polls ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuwyAQxvGnwZstOLBxBoYubOna0cJwJJcSE9nXWHn7ypG6dfsN3_DX93WezoEKLZfPcEfHuU4hMj1xGlpQLZjJNMllREDdoFNWjSfby8E2V5eshoig9Zjm2aDqU9K91Zh1nCMY25ADCUYOoOQJlJadzYPurTEZ4yj7cRZGYiKua3ertPAVc3nVJ65drPemuCvzYxP6Q4AX4Pd97362wDWF1zEQ4Deu60uAX3DfBPhHLcQUD2LByFSXw0eEAC-HtwX4NX-3t7WNy9L-7dqEc2AU4K1RvdFaSmkF-GZ16bFTKbQNVhh5uQcq7zz-_6yng98AAAD__2JyaSQ)and was on the ballot in six states, making him eligible for only 89 electoral college votes. In a statement, Kennedy described his exclusion as "undemocratic, un-American, and cowardly." Kennedy filed a legal complaint to the Federal Election Commission.
## Senate Proposes Draft for Women
A proposal by Senate Democrats to [require women to register for the draft](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuwyAQgOGngY0IzhjsgaELW7p2tAjcxVTYpJg6yttX7dz5l_7h-7gu15BL3u_vYUPXqS4h9nziYgQoAXrRPDlCBBw4OmXVNNtRGstXR_OYKCTSQZElNVkz3CBZmOdIdAuRZwcStDSg5AxqkBdLZhit1oRxkuN0Y1piyr22y2fNe1-Ryque2C6xbry4tffHwYY3Bp6B7yuuuZTfxsA_asnxxcAnJNwPZOC1HeRopDhwDx1Fwq3GFvohGn5954biWTfcRWqBOgPPm0uPZy4lH8YyLe9byH933v93OB38BAAA___nm2B9) ignited protests from Republicans, complicating the passage of the annual National Defense Authorization Act. The proposal, which Congress rejected [before](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGu4yAURL8Gd0T4gsEuKLahy7ZbWhhfbDYYLCCJ8vdPTv26kc5oNDr_7vPdhhjS9tceqJvPs3UtvHCWFHoKYhbdqj0iIO9Q96ofJzUwqbpdryMfV7ALFxKcYKq3dlgmLiffj6BAdEEDA8Ek9GyCnrOb8pIPSgiPbmTDuBDBcA0tl9v_HFLb0cdPfmG5uXx0Ue-tnZXwPwQMAZM-Z67tQgTMNUzAMPnNBMyz0oTvSsC4nLaCtdLjGWOlPhcX0kbf-cBEW6YFt1AblovQtVjfaD1teVylxbpHtHUnYLqi1_MdYgxVKiLYdtgQv8fa75peGn4CAAD__2phaYs), was added to the defense bill in the Armed Services Committee, and while it's not expected to pass, it's likely to delay the bill. Senator Josh Hawley has opposed the provision, calling it "insane," stating that women shouldn't be forced to serve if they don't want to, and criticized Democrats for using the military for social experiments. Currently, only men aged 18-25 must register with the Selective Service, with options for deferments or exemptions if drafted.
## Actor Donald Sutherland Dies at 88
Donald Sutherland, the iconic Canadian actor who appeared in over 200 movies, [passed away on Thursday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O8yAQAJ_G7hwty89CQfE16fK1V1oYlpgTMZHNObq3P-XqK0dTjDQft_kWSi3b_X94sO-5zSH2cvJsJhQTqlmNyWdmZDmyFySsIw2GxtVnSjqxgMgOQBoilAJpcZacdFmnsXgEVGBQgEMh4ULZSE1KZY4WtF0GBZxKb_vls5Wtr5zrdzt5v8T2GKtfe38eg_w34HXAa3hu_Dre6g17L7HygNfUtlDTdHz1lfcatjSlwsdk7AIkZLCOSDmjFmsjQxAxah2jsOPu0_NVai2HoUHB_RFK_e32vy-cHn8CAAD__3nDXGg) at the age of 88. His long career, spanning over 60 years, included memorable performances in classics like the original film version of "_M.A.S.H._ ," "_Klute_ ," "_Ordinary People_ ," and more recently, "_The Hunger Games_ " saga. You can see [his life in pictures here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FuhSAUgOGngQ1zOCDgwNDF7XbtaFAOVxoUo9Smb9-0853_4c_38ZgeIZe8P9_DRr6lOoWl5ZsmI1AK1JPm0SciJMXJSyvdYHswlq9eocLQ69TPxtlFgg3SwaxgkThHOTiePQJqMChhQKmgs8mo3mqdaHHQu5lpoJhbPbvPmve2Uio_9aazW-rGi19bOy6m3hiODMeD6lHoLzEcY91DieL6aiudJexRRApRlJxI5F0ca231Es4YY8Dy08fjO5eSL2OZhucWcvl_tNfi2-NvAAAA__-uPFdF). Sutherland's achievements include an honorary Oscar for his contributions to cinema, an Emmy, and two Golden Globe Awards. He was often noted as one of the best actors never to receive a competitive Academy Award nomination. He is survived by his five children, including actor Kiefer Sutherland.

Unfortunately, a few years ago, radicals began propelling criminals into heroes overnight and campaigning to “ _defund the police_.” I refuse to accept that we must cater to the bottom denominator of our society and that the black community must fight and scream and demand support for the people in our community who are up to no good. That’s one of the reasons I founded BLEXIT — an organization focused on shifting the culture in Black America as well as educating and uplifting minorities through educational programs and acts of community service. **Around the nation, our BLEXIT chapters have supported local officers, while so many others have turned their backs on those who serve our communities. ** **[To join these chapters and stand with police officers, please sign the national petition today.](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/-dpFenxjR72618kWrHM-zA~~/AARclAA~/RgRoV-UAP0RfaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS90cHVzYS1ibGV4aXQvYzA1YzE4MjctMDNhMS00ODM5LTkwYmMtMjMzOWZlZWZhNzIxP3NvdXJjZV9jb2RlPUNCNTA1ODlXA3NwY0IKZnWjTHVmQCt7w1IUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)**

_The first state chapter — BLEXIT North Carolina — paid a visit to local officers in July. Our State Director showered them with thank-you notes and delicious food as a token of BLEXIT’s appreciation._
---
**[If you ‘Back the Blue’ — and believe that we must support local heroes — please sign the national petition right away.](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/-dpFenxjR72618kWrHM-zA~~/AARclAA~/RgRoV-UAP0RfaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS90cHVzYS1ibGV4aXQvYzA1YzE4MjctMDNhMS00ODM5LTkwYmMtMjMzOWZlZWZhNzIxP3NvdXJjZV9jb2RlPUNCNTA1ODlXA3NwY0IKZnWjTHVmQCt7w1IUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)** While the ‘defund the police’ crowd wants us to think minorities stand with them — polls show that the vast majority of black voters (more than 80%) want police funding to stay the same or even increase. We’ve been sold a lot of lies by anti-police radicals — those lies have been a detriment to Black American culture, the country as a whole, and the police officers who fight for justice every day. **We must stop the deception that is harming urban communities and demeaning police around the nation. ** If you are an American, no matter what color you are, you should want law and you should want order. That is the way forward. **[Join me in letting our police officers know that you support law and order, justice, and their valiant efforts to keep our communities safe.](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/-dpFenxjR72618kWrHM-zA~~/AARclAA~/RgRoV-UAP0RfaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS90cHVzYS1ibGV4aXQvYzA1YzE4MjctMDNhMS00ODM5LTkwYmMtMjMzOWZlZWZhNzIxP3NvdXJjZV9jb2RlPUNCNTA1ODlXA3NwY0IKZnWjTHVmQCt7w1IUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)**

subject: Are you fed up with cancel culture?
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| |
---
| | | [](http://trk.secureandprosper.)
---
| Fellow Patriot,

Dr. Carson asked me to reach out to Americans who want what's best for our country, to help him take a stand against "cancel culture." It's tearing our country apart and needs to be stopped.

This is something he has experienced firsthand.

As you may have heard, this past November the Detroit School Board voted to change the name of the Benjamin Carson High School of Science and Medicine. Why? Because the School Board was mad that Dr. Carson was part of the Trump Administration!

These educational leaders - who should be acting as role models for our kids - instead decided to create a huge political spectacle by "canceling" Dr. Carson and trying to erase his amazing achievements as a doctor, as a leader, and as a citizen. It's really outrageous.

Dr. Carson is disappointed by this - not because he wants any glory but because it sets a bad example ... for the kids at this school, and for the entire country.

"Cancel culture" tells young people and all Americans that you shouldn't listen to those with whom you disagree and try to find common ground; you should just stigmatize them and erase them.

The Left probably expected Dr. Carson to lash out at the Detroit School Board and his political opponents - hurl some insults, call people names, keep the fight going.

But instead, Dr. Carson said to our team here at the American Cornerstone Institute (ACI):

_" What if we use this as an opportunity to rally people across the country to speak out against cancel culture? To show America that we have a better path forward for our country than hate and division?"_

And that's exactly what we're doing. It's why Dr. Carson launched ACI in the first place - to lead the way for what's best for our country.

And we've created a way for you to stand with Dr. Carson and make your voice heard. Just click the link below; it will take you to our **National Statement Against Cancel Culture** that you can review and then co-sign.

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/cancel-culture-pledge](http://trk.secureandprosper.)

Dr. Carson is getting asked about the Detroit school incident quite a bit, and when he answers he wants to speak for Americans who are heartbroken by what cancel culture is doing to our country - who want this divisiveness and vitriol to end! I think you're just such an American.

And when you and thousands of concerned citizens like you sign this Statement, Dr. Carson will be able to keep speaking from the heart against cancel culture - knowing that he's broadcasting a message that is important to his fellow Americans.

He can say ... "Enough is enough! I'm fed up with cancel culture, and so are folks everywhere who love America and want what's best for the country."

If that's a message you want Dr. Carson to share on your behalf, please take a moment now to be part of ACI's **National Statement Against Cancel Culture**. Here's the link again for you:

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/cancel-culture-pledge](http://trk.secureandprosper.-GtjkaflxoweNky9EZ9g)

Amid all the divisiveness and polarization that has been injected into our policy debates, Dr. Carson is proud of the work ACI is doing to encourage Americans to come together despite our differences and find ways to take on the challenges that face our country.

I hope you'll join Dr. Carson in this important work. Thank you!

Sincerely,

Andrew D. Hughes
Executive Director & CEO
American Cornerstone Institute

subject: SC03 Sheriffs Stand with Sheri Biggs

body:
Seven esteemed sheriffs from across the district endorsed our campaign, underscoring our shared commitment to law and order, conservative values, and serving our community with integrity.
---
| | | | | | [ ](https://cgnb9.r.ah.d.sendibm5.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsDg0cEbC62mBi3KJrKWON/J6lIseZHDcSa)
---
| **Dear Neighbor,** I hope this email finds you well. I'm excited to share some incredible news from the campaign trail! Seven esteemed sheriffs from across South Carolina's Third Congressional District have officially endorsed my candidacy for Congress. This powerful show of support underscores our shared commitment to law and order, conservative values, and serving our community with integrity. And, it shows the strong momentum we have heading into Tuesday's runoff election! **Meet the Sheriffs Supporting Our Campaign:**
* Sheriff Ray Watson, Abbeville County
* Sheriff Chad McBride, Anderson County
* Sheriff Jody Rowland, Edgefield County
* Sheriff Clarke Stearns, McCormick County
* Sheriff Lee Foster, Newberry County
* Sheriff Mike Crenshaw, Oconee County
* Sheriff Josh Price, Saluda County

**Why Their Support Matters:** Edgefield County Sheriff Jody Rowland eloquently put it: "Sheri Biggs' unwavering integrity, proven leadership, and steadfast commitment to conservative values make her the ideal candidate for South Carolina's Third Congressional District. Her honorable background stands in stark contrast to her opponent, and her dedication to supporting law enforcement and upholding the rule of law is exactly what our district needs." Sheriff Chad McBride of Anderson County, a fellow military service member, also highlighted the importance of my continued service, both in uniform and as a supporter of local veterans' mental health. "Sheri Biggs will fight for our veterans, work to secure the border, and support local law enforcement," he said. **Our Campaign Vision:** I am deeply honored by these endorsements and remain committed to addressing the challenges our district faces. Together, we will:
* Secure our borders and protect our communities from illegal immigration and the dangers it brings.
* Uphold fiscal responsibility, ensuring that our tax dollars are spent wisely and transparently.
* Defend the sanctity of life and promote a culture that values every individual.
* Stand with our law enforcement officers and first responders, providing them with the resources and respect they deserve.
* Fight for the rights of our veterans, ensuring they receive the care and recognition they have earned.

**Get Involved:** Our campaign is built on grassroots support, and we need your help in the final days of the runoff to succeed. Here’s how you can get involved:
1. ** _Volunteer_ :** Join our team by knocking on doors, making phone calls, and spreading the word about our campaign. Reply to this email if you’re willing to help.
2. **_Donate_ :** Every contribution, no matter how big or small, makes a significant impact. [Make a secure online donation by clicking here](https://cgnb9.r.ah.d.sendibm5.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsE8LKR1aS8hLy79hgJG6R/R7ZO7nlhycel).
3. **_Spread the Word_ :** Follow us on Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram. Like, comment, and share our posts to help amplify our message.
4. **_VOTE_** : Today - Friday, June 21st - is the last day of Early Voting. Election Day is Tuesday, June 25th. Whether it is voting today, during Early Voting, or on Tuesday - your vote can make the difference in what is expected to be a low turnout election.

Thank you for your continued support. Together, we can heal our nation and bring strong, conservative leadership to Washington. Sincerely, Sheri Biggs

| Peter,

Yesterday, we hosted our virtual town hall, where we discussed news from the front lines, updates from the U.S. Supreme Court, and new threats to essential reproductive health care emerging at the state level.

Most importantly we discussed what YOU can do to help us protect reproductive rights. And even if you weren't able to join us, you can still be part of what's next: [**from now until June 30, all contributions to the Center will be MATCHED 6X, up to $150,000!**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/87302476/480713732/1859933966?sourceid=1149676&utm_campaign=24emfr062422aax&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=fye&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZTI4NDAyZC1jNzJmLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vTOcbnB6zY60JgmkBB8aFa-r9UyrQI8aMJ4F6G5a5lU=&emci=e58efc88-322f-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=ce28402d-c72f-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=954237) | [**MATCH YOUR GIFT 6X**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/87302477/480713733/1859933966?sourceid=1149676&utm_campaign=24emfr062422aax&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=fye&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZTI4NDAyZC1jNzJmLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vTOcbnB6zY60JgmkBB8aFa-r9UyrQI8aMJ4F6G5a5lU=&emci=e58efc88-322f-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=ce28402d-c72f-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=954237 "MATCH YOUR GIFT 6X")
---

I launched _**Let 's Address This **_to fight for human rights and maintain media accountability. Last week [I published an article citing ADL data on antisemitism in America](https://substack.com/redirect/a1aff0b4-8957-488f-9dd2-4e9387aa3c76?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). And citing ADL data I demonstrated that:
> According to the ADL, since 2002, there have been zero antisemitic hate crimes from Muslims, zero antisemitic hate crimes from leftists, and meanwhile the Right has been responsible for an incredible, a horrifying, a sickening 100% of antisemitic hate crimes--totaling at least 3058 antisemitic hate crimes.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2550223&post_id=145814144&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ1ODE0MTQ0LCJpYXQiOjE3MTg5NzUyNjMsImV4cCI6MTcyMTU2NzI2MywiaXNzIjoicHViLTI1NTAyMjMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.tT_UHjgefJhwiwSztBnae-hIsnDIkGH3x5jr8csPk-4)
**However** , since publishing that article, three significant developments have occurred. It is important I share these updates to stay aligned with my founding promise of being unassailable in my advocacy of human rights and media accountability, especially because the updates impact the very ADL data I shared.
One--since I published the ADL data by citing their own H.E.A.T. Map, the ADL changed their own website and removed the ability to search hate crimes by motivating ideology. My screenshots provided in my post demonstrate the past ability users had to search antisemitic hate crimes committed by left wing, right wing, or 'Islamist' ideology. After my piece was published, proving that even the ADL admits 100% of hate crimes come from the right, the ADL removed the ability for future researchers to determine the motivating ideology behind a particular antisemitic hate crime. I found this incredibly concerning as this lack of transparency is certainly not indicative of an organization committed to truth or reliable trustworthy data--hence the second significant development.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3e10e1fe-a672-4a1f-b41b-0699c4c338f6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Two--citing ADL's unreliable data, Wikipedia editors have, by democratic consensus, voted to declare the Anti-Defamation League "[generally unreliable](https://substack.com/redirect/3316f1aa-eb11-4342-ab06-d82fa9e33ab7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. This decision came down to unreliability in the data overall, and unreliability in ADL leadership specifically.

Regarding the ADL's overall data unreliability The Jewish Telegraph Agency ("JTA") [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/3316f1aa-eb11-4342-ab06-d82fa9e33ab7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> ...in a near consensus, dozens of Wikipedia editors involved in the discussion said they believe the ADL should not be cited for factual information on antisemitism as well because it acts primarily as a pro-Israel organization and tends to label legitimate criticism of Israel as antisemitism. "ADL no longer appears to adhere to a serious, mainstream and intellectually cogent definition of antisemitism, but has instead given into the shameless politicization of the very subject that it was originally esteemed for being reliable on," wrote an editor known as [Iskandar323](https://substack.com/redirect/4fca52e8-7471-4780-a341-a871d36cb3db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), whose request for a discussion about the ADL ultimately led to the ban.
And regarding ADL leadership [specifically](https://substack.com/redirect/3316f1aa-eb11-4342-ab06-d82fa9e33ab7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the JTA reports:
> Also cited were a series of controversial statements by ADL CEO Jonathan Greenblatt, who [has claimed student protests were Iranian proxies](https://substack.com/redirect/b9f7e24b-a8c6-4429-8c49-65af78913aed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [compared the keffiyeh head scarf to the swastika](https://substack.com/redirect/a877a996-418f-44db-99fd-eb4dd8ededdb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [praised Elon Musk after he promoted an antisemitic post](https://substack.com/redirect/b3fbdc0d-2f34-423d-ad47-68cf4f9c8809?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on his social media platform X, and [compared anti-Zionism to white supremacy](https://substack.com/redirect/20eef86f-b55b-4bc7-9035-5799b33d2600?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Editors pointed to [news reporting about a staff revolt in January](https://substack.com/redirect/88c06606-2355-4988-bd3e-d47e112bf94d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) against Greenblatt's statements.
And this brings me to the third significant development of which I became aware since last week--what does the ADL count as an antisemitic hate crime? My fair assumption was that the ADL followed the accepted definition by the U.S. Department of Justice, [which defines a hate crime as](https://substack.com/redirect/e2e33830-9afb-41d2-a316-1df883bafb9d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> "acts of violence or threats of violence motivated by bias based on statutorily-protected characteristics. This includes acts of physical harm and specific criminal threats motivated by animus based on race, color, national origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability."
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..aI8Rm5dWhLwoCY-wY33CTNU5Tse61x2EXACv03hmukA?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=145814144)
Accordingly, I expected the ADL to document hate crimes against Jewish people that were acts of violence or threats of violence motivated by antisemitism. However, this appears not to be the case. Data scientist Rebekah Jones analyzed the ADL's data as of May 3 and demonstrated the ADL data [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/3d1e4287-a91f-4c0f-a3ce-20a69096185b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) something quite different than the DOJ's definition. Rebekah Jones writes:
* According to the [2023 audit](https://substack.com/redirect/c40afb86-e8cc-43a6-b3df-754c11c9a4de?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of what the ADL claimed were antisemitic attacks/hate crimes:
* 230 of the 300 most recent reports were for stickers people claim to have seen, including stickers saying "America First."
* 52% of the "attacks" were about Israel or Zionism. The ADL includes references to Israel and Zionism, including saying "Fuck Israel" as a hate crime against Jews.
* The ADL included all 1,352 anti-war rallies since October 7 as "hate groups" and "antisemitic incidents" Those rallies make up 1/6th of the more than 8,000 "antisemitic" incidents they report.
* To quote the ADL, opposition to Israel is now terrorism against Jews: "We saw an explosion of anti-Israel activism that incorporated expressions of opposition to Zionism, as well as support for resistance against Israel or Zionists that could be perceived as supporting terrorism or attacks on Jews, Israelis or Zionists."

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e987e0d0-02c7-45aa-b49d-48a20e893948?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Trump's "America First" flags are being sold on Amazon
The MAGA "America First" slogan is certainly a racist slogan (and reinforces the right wing seeming monopoly on antisemitism). "F--k Israel" is certainly a vulgar phrase. I employ neither. But to be clear, I know of no legal precedent in American history where racist speech or vulgar language _alone_ rises to the status of "acts of violence or threats of violence," which could thus be classified as a hate crime. Undoubtedly, antisemitism is absolutely condemnable without exception. And that is why it is that much more critical we rely on reliable data. Unfortunately, because it appears the ADL has not provided reliable data, and is instead further censoring the data it previously posted, I felt compelled to write this update to better contextualize and qualify my previous article.
I am hopeful the ADL will reverse course and commit to authentic and reliable data collection and reporting methods going forward. Otherwise, the near [unanimous consensus of Wikipedia editors](https://substack.com/redirect/3316f1aa-eb11-4342-ab06-d82fa9e33ab7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) will have to remain that the ADL, "...is now [grouped together](https://substack.com/redirect/a0f3b6d9-a2b8-4c92-abc3-d8487c80d3a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with the National Inquirer, Newsmax, and Occupy Democrats as a source of propaganda or misinformation..."
In the meantime, I've added a disclaimer to my earlier piece and linked this piece for future readers. My commitment is firm to continue fighting for human rights and demanding media accountability--while being unassailable with my facts and research. Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to receive this CONSERVATIVE NEWS ALERT from Illinois Review (https://www.illinoisreview.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c8195a940c-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .

Don Tracy Ally Jeanne Ives Attacks Grassroots, IR, Trump Jr. Event, and Now Setting Sights on IL GOP Chairmanship (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/don-tracy-ally-jeanne-ives-attacks-grassroots-ir-trump-jr-event-and-now-setting-sights-on-il-gop-chairmanship.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c8195a940c-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/don-tracy-ally-jeanne-ives-attacks-grassroots-ir-trump-jr-event-and-now-setting-sights-on-il-gop-chairmanship.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c8195a940c-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

By Illinois Review
Ever since news broke that embattled Illinois Republican Party Chairman Don Tracy was resigning effective July 19th, Illinois GOP state central committee member Jeanne Ives has been working the phones trying to gauge support as she considers a potential run for the party’s top spot – despite spending the last two years angering the very base that made her, and was instrumental in Tracy’s decision to resign.

In December of 2022, Ives stunned a room full of over 200 grassroots activists during a SSC meeting when she defended then IL GOP Finance Chairman
Vince Kolber (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2022/12/il-gop-treasurer-to-grassroots-during-meeting-if-you-havent-donated-then-why-are-you-here.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c8195a940c-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , who had just insulted the grassroots for not donating money to the state party – yelling – in an almost out of body experience that, “Vince is not your problem! This man gave me $750,000 when I ran against Gov. Bruce Rauner!”
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/don-tracy-ally-jeanne-ives-attacks-grassroots-ir-trump-jr-event-and-now-setting-sights-on-il-gop-chairmanship.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c8195a940c-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/don-tracy-ally-jeanne-ives-attacks-grassroots-ir-trump-jr-event-and-now-setting-sights-on-il-gop-chairmanship.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c8195a940c-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Just months before challenging Gov. Rauner in the GOP primary, Ives was seen smiling for a photo with her soon-to-be Republican political opponent.
Last September, Ives endorsed Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis for president during the 2024 presidential primary, despite the wildly popular former president Donald Trump leading in the polls among Republicans over his political opponents, including DeSantis by over 30 points. And when Ives learned that the president’s son – Donald Trump Jr. was coming to Illinois to promote Letters to Trump last October (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/09/am-560-host-jeanne-ives-has-history-of-slamming-ir-says-conservative-publication-full-of-lies-and-garbage-falsely-alleges-trump-jr-event-cant-sell-ticke.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c8195a940c-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , her team made requests to interview Trump Jr. on her radio show, and to speak on stage during the event. When the requests were turned down, and this publication accurately reported about it, she became angry – and went on Facebook attacking the event featuring Trump Jr. and falsely alleged that the hosts couldn’t sell tickets.

And over the last two years, Ives continues to trash this publication (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/09/am-560-host-jeanne-ives-has-history-of-slamming-ir-says-conservative-publication-full-of-lies-and-garbage-falsely-alleges-trump-jr-event-cant-sell-ticke.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c8195a940c-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) – the leading conservative news publication in the state. In an interview with Crain’s Chicago Business (https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.chicagobusiness.com/greg-hinz-politics/conservative-news-site-illinois-review-critical-gop-insiders&sa=D&source=docs&ust=1718909823142902&usg=AOvVaw33ZIEF-hEYm_Hu_j9hoXfI&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c8195a940c-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) in April of 2023, Ives offered a stunning on-the-record quote when asked to comment about IR, stating, “I don’t read their garbage.” Sources also confirm to IR that during that same time frame last Spring, Ives proposed in a private meeting that the SSC ban this publication, including then publisher Scott Kaspar and editor-in-chief Mark Vargas from attending all future IL GOP meetings. The proposal
was immediately shot down and the discussion shifted to another topic.
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/don-tracy-ally-jeanne-ives-attacks-grassroots-ir-trump-jr-event-and-now-setting-sights-on-il-gop-chairmanship.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c8195a940c-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/don-tracy-ally-jeanne-ives-attacks-grassroots-ir-trump-jr-event-and-now-setting-sights-on-il-gop-chairmanship.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=c8195a940c-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
Ever since her election to the Republican State Central Committee in 2022, Ives has abandoned her grassroots base for the IL GOP elites – becoming part of the establishment instead of opposing it.

And never one to shy away from controversy, the former grassroots activist has never called on Don Tracy to resign – despite her base advocating for it.

She never called on Kolber – who votes in Wisconsin and Illinois as a full time resident of both states simultaneously – to apologize for saying such offensive remarks to the grassroots during the SSC meeting in December of 2022.

She never called on former Chicago GOP Chairman Steve Boulton to walk back his recently discovered Facebook comment in 2015 when he compared Donald Trump to Adolf Hitler.

And she never called out former SSC member Mark Shaw, who faked a delegate badge and threatened to beat up a fellow state central committee member during the IL GOP state convention last month – and demanded that he resign. In fact, during the state convention, Ives cut a deal and backed Shaw for national committeeman over the grassroots-backed candidate Dean White. And in early June, when the grassroots sent her emails about investigating Shaw’s behavior, Ives angrily posted a comment on her Facebook page, writing, “canned emails get a canned response.” The comment drew an immediate backlash as Republicans fired back calling Ives’ comment “ignorant” and “belittling” to the constituents she’s supposed to represent.

While Ives is busy making phone calls trying to gauge support for a potential run at party chairwoman, sources have shared with this publication that she has very little support from SSC members – and that her elevation to state party chair is more than a long shot – it’s an impossibility.

And never one to shy away from controversy, the former grassroots activist has never called on Don Tracy to resign – despite her base advocating for it. She never called on Kolber – who votes in Wisconsin and Illinois as a full time resident of both states simultaneously – to apologize for saying such offensive remarks to the grassroots during the SSC meeting in December of 2022. She never called on former Chicago GOP Chairman Steve Boulton to walk back his recently discovered Facebook comment in 2015 when he compared Donald Trump to Adolf Hitler. And she never called out former SSC member Mark Shaw, who faked a delegate badge and threatened to beat up a fellow state central committee member during the IL GOP state convention last month – and demanded that he resign. In fact, during the state convention, Ives cut a deal and backed Shaw for national committeeman over the grassroots-backed candidate Dean White. And in early June, when the grassroots sent her emails about investigating Shaw’s behavior, Ives angrily posted a comment on her Facebook page, writing, “canned emails get a canned response.” The comment drew an immediate backlash as Republicans fired back calling Ives’ comment “ignorant” and “belittling” to the constituents she’s supposed to represent. While Ives is busy making phone calls trying to gauge support for a potential run at party chairwoman, sources have shared with this publication that she has very little support from SSC members – and that her elevation to state party chair is more than a long shot – it’s an impossibility. When I

which I've found helps provide answers and strength in these dark
days.

never before - you'll be encouraged!

subject: A million puzzle pieces. Here’s yours.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1561%2E135344%2Ey41g0e)

Friend --
In a state like Michigan with historically close elections, a winning campaign is made up of a million puzzle pieces that have to come together in order to deliver the result we all want to see.
**There are the big pieces in our race** : what opponent are we going to get in the general election? What is going to happen with the presidential election at the top of the ticket, and how will it impact Democratic, Republican and Independent voters?
**There are the unexpected pieces we can't predict** : like when Supreme Court Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg died just weeks before the 2020 election. Or when _Roe_ was overturned before the 2022 election.
**There are the countless small but meaningful pieces** : What will be the response every time Trump visits? What will various outside super PACs decide to do in our race and when?
**Then there are the million micro pieces** : will an individual voter of ours be able to make it to the polls after their kid gets a sore throat? Will a volunteer be able to make a shift to contact the voters we need to reach after their car breaks down?
[**And then there's your puzzle piece -- the one we're asking you to claim today: will you make today the day you donate your first contribution to help us reach our fundraising goals before this FEC deadline comes to a close? **](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-june24.nyVfY7&refcode=em240621-1-t1&t=2&akid=1561%2E135344%2Ey41g0e)

| Hey Peter – A few years ago, Georgia spent $1.5 million dollars to overhaul their campaign finance website so the public could know who funds campaigns and politicians. But despite pouring resources into it, the new website is barely functional. **In fact, the Georgia campaign finance system needs so much work that I built an open source python script to deal with compliance myself.** [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T0a73f9a3-8049-4726-9f27-d8740eabdb1c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) [**This is a prime example of why we need people like me with tech backgrounds in public office. Can you split a donation between my campaign and Blue Amp Action so I can make this a reality and win my race for State Senate in November?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9ad84862-27aa-4d54-91c3-cac062abd858/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| Our elected officials are responsible for deciding where taxpayer dollars are spent. When they don’t understand the issues they’re trying to address – like fixing a broken campaign finance website – they end up misusing important funds that could be spent elsewhere. And it’s really important for the public to easily know where campaign finance contributions are spent, and who is spending it. In just a few hours, I was able to hack something together to improve a system that Georgia spent millions of dollars trying to fix. Nobody else in the State Senate has a computer science degree. My expertise will only be more important as our legislature works to regulate AI and the technology of the future. [**Peter, if you believe that people like me should have a seat at the table in our government to avoid wasting taxpayer dollars on solutions that don’t work, split a donation to my campaign for State Senate and Blue Amp Action today.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T03616e77-ea21-45e6-a886-781ff40ad0b1/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

name: Tammy Baldwin
subject: When I came out in college
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
#

Hey everybody, it’s Mark Kelly. My friend Tammy Baldwin is running for re-election to the Senate in 2024, and we’re working to support her. I hope you’ll read the message below from her, and [**consider splitting a donation between Tammy's campaign and mine.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-baldwin.7r5nHM&refcode=em2404621-1-30&t=1&akid=5787%2E6688874%2E3BKo6S)
---

Hi there, can I share something with you?
When I came out in college, I knew I was interested in a career in public service. But I feared that I would have to face a serious choice between pursuing the field of my dreams or living my authentic life openly.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-baldwin.7r5nHM&refcode=em2404621-1-30&t=2&akid=5787%2E6688874%2E3BKo6S)
After seeing others in the LGBTQ+ community demonstrate acts of courage by coming out, being themselves, and being public about who they are and who they love, I came to realize that I could do both:
**I could run for office and be honest about who I am — so that’s exactly what I did.**
When I became the first openly gay Senator elected in our nation’s history, I understood that I needed to use this extraordinary opportunity to make a difference in people's lives. From lowering prescription drug prices to protecting same-sex marriage through the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , I’ve worked hard every day since to do just that.
That's why I ran for office in the first place — not to make history, but to make a difference. And folks like you supported me because you wanted to make a difference, too.
[**I’m facing my most competitive and expensive reelection yet, so I can’t keep up this work without your help. Will you help me continue to make a difference by splitting a donation between Mark Kelly and my reelection campaign today?**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-baldwin.7r5nHM&refcode=em2404621-1-30&t=3&akid=5787%2E6688874%2E3BKo6S)
**[DONATE NOW](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-baldwin.7r5nHM&refcode=em2404621-1-30&t=4&akid=5787%2E6688874%2E3BKo6S)**
We have made incredible progress over the years in the fight for equality — but everybody, we cannot mistake that progress for a total victory.
Republican-led state legislatures across the country continue to pass harmful legislation, especially targeting the transgender community and LGBTQ+ youth. **In 2024 alone, 515 anti-LGBTQ+ bills have been introduced across the country.**
It’s going to take all of us to counter these right wing attacks so everyone grows up knowing they belong, and that kindness and inclusion — not hatred and division — are American values.
[**This Pride Month, I’m hoping you’ll support this important work by splitting a donation between Mark Kelly and my reelection campaign to send me back to the United States Senate.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-baldwin.7r5nHM&refcode=em2404621-1-30&t=5&akid=5787%2E6688874%2E3BKo6S)
_If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly:_

---
****

Thank you for your ongoing support. Let’s recommit ourselves to work towards the day when all LGBTQ+ Americans can live in a world where they feel safe, accepted, and loved.
Happy Pride! 🏳️🌈
— Tammy

## **Michael Cloud Wants To Defund Law Enforcement**
---
Michael Cloud is seeking to use his power on the Appropriations Committee to defund Alvin Bragg and Fani Willis for upholding the rule of law, punishing them for simply doing their jobs. This is a power Michael Cloud does not put to good use to invest in our district. No leadership to address our rural health care crisis or invest in the infrastructure that grows our economy. A sustained track record of voting against infrastructure investments for Nueces, Aransas, San Patricio, Refugio, Bee, Goliad, Victoria, Calhoun, Jackson, Lavaca, DeWitt, Gonzales, Caldwell, and Bastrop counties – Is this who we want representing us in Congress?
---
We have our best chance in years to elect a Representative that will go to Congress to champion the needs of our district, rather than spend his time doing stunts that show he doesn’t support the rule of law.Our nominee is Tanya Lloyd. She will work to invest in TX-27 to improve our infrastructure and our economy. She will work to address our rural health care crisis. She will protect IVF and restore women’s reproductive rights.Tanya Lloyd grew up in TX-27, first in Robstown and later in Lockhart. She is a first grade teacher and Michael Cloud proves every day that _**Congress Needs A First Grade Teacher**_.Tanya knows first hand the challenges families face with difficult pregnancies, with [her daughter being born ten weeks premature](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=66758ce61e4d77130cf4349f&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tanyafortx27.com%2Fjenna%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D66722a25aa162b4445923280%26ss_email_id%3D66758ce61e4d77130cf4349f%26ss_campaign_name%3DStand%2BAgainst%2BMichael%2BCloud%25E2%2580%2599s%2BEfforts%2Bto%2BDefund%2BAlvin%2BBragg%2Band%2BFani%2BWillis%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2024-06-21T14%253A24%253A19Z&w=658f0ec36f3fe00284167a1e&c=b_66722a25aa162b4445923280&l=en-US&s=XM-X_2QmXsvysadUXbYO4sjcZx0%3D). This is personal experience we need in Congress as reproductive health care is endangered by extremists like Michael Cloud.In the past several months, Tanya has driven over 16,000 miles across TX-27 talking to voters in the district. She has participated in parades from Yoakum to Lockhart, a Juneteenth festival in Port Lavaca, hosted BBQs, and attended fundraisers and community events meeting voters. With your help volunteering and donating, we are going to out work Michael Cloud and help elect a Congresswoman we can be proud of. A woman focused on serving TX-27 and not on the gimmicks Michael Cloud spends his time on.Please donate today. Our country needs you in the arena alongside Tanya.

Peter, it’s an understatement to say that the House of Representatives under Republican control is a _disaster._

distract from Donald Trump’s legal problems. They will never stop doing

name: PoliticsPA
subject: Don't Miss It: Big Event on Monday
body:
| | | |
---
| | |
---
| _Voice of Reason_ will be recording its signature podcast at the Capitol Rotunda in Harrisburg on **Monday at 2pm**.

If you’re new to VOR, we’re a community of politicians, business leaders, and policy aficionados on both sides who have respectful conversations on the issues you care about most. We also share exclusive data on elections, voter sentiment, and policy in each episode.

Join on us on June 24th because your voice matters.

**The Details** :
Where: Harrisburg Capitol Rotunda
When: 2pm – 4pm
Who: BallotPA, Electronic Payment Coalition, PA Chamber of Business & Industry, and special guest legislators.
---
| **The Experience**
---
| We'll be discussing a proposal to eliminate fees on the sales tax components of purchases, the debate over having open primaries in Pennsylvania, and sending a message to startups that Pennsylvania is open for business.
---
| _Why It Matters_
---
| **BallotPA** is advocating for Open Primaries in Pennsylvania to ensure that all voters can participate fully in the state's election process. Meanwhile, the **Electronic Payment Coalition** is cautioning against the passage of HB 2394, arguing it will "completely disrupt" the state's electronic payment systems. Additionally, the **PA Chamber** is calling for reforms to the state's "uniquely harsh" treatment of net operating losses (NOLs) to promote economic growth and attract new businesses.
---
|
* * *
---
| **In Case You Missed It**
---
| **Senator Tim Kearney** made the case for changing the basic way that Pennsylvania funds school districts – by moving away from the state's dependence on property taxes. [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=965dd970d7&e=b7b3eddce2)]

**Director of the Franklin & Marshall College Poll Berwood Yost** illustrated how surveys on the state's overall direction, personal finances, and key voter issues are much better predictors of an election than "horse race" polls about which candidate is ahead. [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=a8bfdff8c2&e=b7b3eddce2)]

**AFSCME District Council 47 Legislative Director Robert Harris** explained why Starbucks workers are unionizing – to pursue the benefits of organized labor including living wages and worker protections. [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=60e3bfdc85&e=b7b3eddce2)]
---
|
* * *
---
| **Number of the Day**
---
| As of April 2024, the partisan breakdown of PA voters registering for the first time is **38% Democrat, 32% Republican, and 26% non-partisan**.

**44% of these voters are under the age of 24** , with the single largest group being those aged 18-19. [[L2 Data](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=0133b289f6&e=b7b3eddce2)]

If you’re new to VOR, we’re a community of politicians, business leaders, and policy aficionados on both sides who have respectful conversations on the issues you care about most. We also share exclusive data on elections, voter sentiment, and policy in each episode. Join on us on June 24th because your voice matters. The Details : Where: Harrisburg Capitol Rotunda When: 2pm – 4pm Who: BallotPA, Electronic Payment Coalition, PA Chamber of Business & Industry, and special guest legislators. | The Experience | We'll be discussing a proposal to eliminate fees on the sales tax components of purchases, the debate over having open primaries in Pennsylvania, and sending a message to startups that Pennsylvania is open for business. | Why It Matters | BallotPA is advocating for Open Primaries in Pennsylvania to ensure that all voters can participate fully in the state's election process. Meanwhile, the Electronic Payment Coalition is cautioning against the passage of HB 2394, arguing it will "completely disrupt" the state's electronic payment systems. Additionally, the PA Chamber is calling for reforms to the state's "uniquely harsh" treatment of net operating losses (NOLs) to promote economic growth and attract new businesses. | | In Case You Missed It | Senator Tim Kearney made the case for changing the basic way that Pennsylvania funds school districts – by moving away from the state's dependence on property taxes. ] Director of the Franklin & Marshall College Poll Berwood Yost illustrated how surveys on the state's overall direction, personal finances, and key voter issues are much better predictors of an election than "horse race" polls about which candidate is ahead. ] AFSCME District Council 47 Legislative Director Robert Harris explained why Starbucks workers are unionizing – to pursue the benefits of organized labor including living wages and worker protections. ] | | Number of the Day | As of April 2024, the partisan breakdown of PA voters registering for the first time is 38% Democrat, 32% Republican, and 26% non-partisan. 44% of these voters are under the age of 24 , with the single largest group being those aged 18-19. ] | Featured Partner Content | Visit GuardYourCard | | Get in Touch | We like smart ideas and want to hear from you. | | | Manhattan prosecutors are urging the NY judge overseeing Trump's criminal case to keep his gag order in place, given the danger he presents. And we agree 100%. [**Add your name, and tell the judge to keep the gag order in place.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tae9579f4-2df0-4a51-bad6-1ece8157a17e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _In court papers filed Friday, prosecutors with the Manhattan district attorney's office argued that portions of the gag order remained necessary given Trump's "singular history of inflammatory and threatening public statements," as well as efforts by his supporters to "identify jurors and threaten violence against him."_ _" Since the verdict in this case, defendant has not exempted the jurors from his alarming rhetoric that he would have 'every right' to seek retribution as president against the participants in this trial as a consequence of his conviction because 'sometimes revenge can be justified," the filing states. (source)_ The danger is real, and Trump has shown no interest in changing his ways. He earned the gag order, and he deserves to have it kept in place. [**Add your name, and tell the judge to keep the gag order in place.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td9c0a38a-c962-440c-856a-2981acd5611a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Dear Peter,
We are currently facing a massive censorship campaign.
This follows Facebook’s Meta censorship effort, including throttling down the biographical film about RFK Jr.
The overwhelming reports from thousands of you highlight a deeply troubling pattern of suppression on Meta’s platforms, Facebook and Instagram.
Today, we’re facing a new wave of deplatforming. Comments urging CNN to let Bobby debate are being systematically removed from social media platforms (see screenshot).
---
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=meta_6_21_24_resend_nondonor_1&n=3)
Here’s how you can help:
1. Fight Back on Social Media: Use the hashtags #protestcnn and #letbobbydebate to support RFK Jr. and fight censorship.
2. Call out Censorship! If your posts are taken down, please send details to [censorship@teamkennedy.com](mailto:censorship@teamkennedy.com). Your reports are vital as they contribute to our ongoing legal efforts and help us track the widespread muzzling of RFK Jr.
3. Donate Now: Nothing is as helpful as your donation–as it fuels our legal battles against blatant censorship by Big Tech. Every dollar keeps our message alive and strong. [Donate Now.](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=meta_6_21_24_resend_nondonor_1&n=4)

Censorship is bigger than our Presidential campaign–it’s about the rights of a free people to participate in a free country.
Currently we are pursuing legal action against Facebook’s Meta in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California. With your help today, we will continue to stand firm in our resolve to not let our voices be silenced.
Together we can win. Together we can ensure every American has equal access to the digital public square.
Thank you for standing with us.
Together, we are powerful.
Team Kennedy

| | 1\. In Defense Of Our President: Winning, Not Whining
---
| | Imagine raising a child in a house where the only conversation is an obsession with an evil, corrupt person who inflicts pain and misery on others—and this is all they hear, which means it is all they know. There is no place in this house for stories about good, hope, and a better future, only fear. How do you think that child is going to turn out? What will their view of the world be? Let in stories of good, hope, and a better future, or you will manifest your destiny and theirs. We kicked off the [Pledge: Silence = Death](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/a9P0xQFL9/c?w=g1DbNLXU9xa1HltCPQATQeyTc9XdzWIqbJt3_UC1xiQ.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucnVyYWxhbWVyaWNhbnN1bml0ZWQub3JnL2hvbWUvcGxlZGdlIiwiciI6IjNjNTE0YzYwLTIzZmUtNDdlNS1iOTFiLTU4Y2RjMTlhZWE5NSIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9) last week, and thank you to the many people who have responded thus far. Now more than ever, our President needs our support, and the best and easiest way we can do this is by promoting pro-Democrat and pro-Biden information. We can no longer allow the media to profit by pandering to the lowest common denominator and glorifying the Republican opponent, MAGA, and its minions. To earn our marketing dollars and respect, they need to publish news that is worthy, reflective of the good work Biden and Democrats are doing, and engage in fair and accurate reporting. We ensure they do this by withholding our attention from scandalous posts, articles, and news programs, and by directing our subscription dollars, likes, comments, and shares to what is strengthening our country and building a future where we all thrive.
---
| |
---
| | Everywhere we turn, we see the need for us to do better in our management of the media. Last Sunday, while on the stairmaster at the gym, I watched Fox, Fox Sunday Edition, and CNN. Fox was defending Biden against the inaccurate portrayal of him in recent social media posts. Fox Sunday Edition criticized the congressional GOP for blocking Democratic-led legislation to bring ethics standards to the Supreme Court. However, CNN was a steady drumbeat of Trump, Trump, Trump... The Lincoln Project has become well known for their defense of Democratic values, and a person wrote to me saying I should follow their media posts because they "get it right." I looked at the last ten Instagram posts of the Lincoln Project, and every one of them was about Trump, Trump, Trump. Not a good word to be had for the good being done in our great nation by Biden and our Democratic leadership.

He is young and was one of the strongest proponents of Democratic action among social media influencers. He's been to the White House and recently received accolades from CNN for his work with the youth vote. When he started, he was all about supporting Democrats, but when Democrats switched from promoting Biden to bashing Trump, so did he. Now his feeds are almost exclusively about Trump, with barely a mention of Biden. Not even Biden’s well-paid campaign managers can find anything good to say about him. The Biden campaign is spending $50 million to launch advertisements, like this one, about—you guessed it—Trump. The first three seconds of a video are critical, as 50% of viewers drop off, and another 50% after seven seconds. Biden doesn't appear in his own video until thirteen seconds in!

| | 2\. We Have Proof: Newly Registered Voter Campaign
---
| | Rural Americans United's Newly Registered Voter Campaign is set to launch this month reaching out to over 30,000 potential new voters. Under the excellent guidance of our steering committee, our database of Washington State voter data is built, we have a list of eager volunteers, we have lined up a union printer, contacted every Democratic party in Central and Eastern Washington with the exception of Columbia County (does anyone have contact information for Columbia County Dems?), submitted two grant requests for additional funding, and confirmed our messaging strategy. Why are we reaching out to newly registered voters? This group is largely composed of youth and new citizens. They have no voting history and will fall outside the boundaries of most campaign strategies. It is strategically imperative that we make first contact, "immunize" them against the far-right and MAGA rhetoric, develop a dialogue with them to offer an alternative and informed option, and include them in the democratic process. Our messaging strategy is not traditionally issues-based, but broader. We believe, and studies support, that the majority of this group, particularly youth, has low knowledge of issues, low interest in specific issues as a driver of their daily decisions, and will find the specificity of healthcare, education, and party politics too obtuse and unrelatable. Instead, we have approached it from a contextual perspective, relating to life events and emotions. Here is the first proof draft. Language and editing are not confirmed, but this should give a good idea of our direction.

| | 4\. The Race For Congressional Districts 4 and 5 Update
---
| | The Congressional House races for districts 4 and 5 are well underway. With less than two months until the primary, all eyes are on the candidates to see who can "bring it" and make it through to the primary. Both districts 4 and 5 are crowded with Democrats, making it an exceptional challenge for them to reach the general election. We have [outlined a real path to victory](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/a9P0xQFL9/c?w=rjVtd_ufsRTwghVtvCPb4fhT4XnSezI0jYL-VlSaWsw.) for Democrats in congressional district 5, and with this being an open seat, it is a once-in-a-generation opportunity that will determine whether extreme far-right politics continues to strangle rural Washington. However, it appears this is a high-stakes race of personalities rather than party unity, and the future of 1.5 million people living in Central and Eastern Washington is at stake. Below is the FEC reporting of the congressional district 5 campaign contributions for the first quarter of 2024. What I see as encouraging here is that the top Republican candidate has only raised $400,000, which may suggest they are expecting an easy win. Perhaps an unexpected surprise by Democrats might upset the apple cart. Unfortunately, Democrats are not well known for unexpected surprises.. Congressional District 4 candidates [Muchlinski](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/a9P0xQFL9/c?w=pQzgBHxSvc8UuOqH97q235pEqsHwGdt4y8rTWqKmRfs.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZmVjLmdvdi9kYXRhL2NhbmRpZGF0ZS9INFdBMDQxODcvIiwiciI6IjM3MjE0NTNjLWQwMzktNDNkYS04OWY3LTdjODJlOTBhMmEwYSIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9) and [Baechler](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/a9P0xQFL9/c?w=gndbpXfbM1RZZqujm4OZ1VqfIBM5oZrYVutTECCtHyA.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZmVjLmdvdi9kYXRhL2NhbmRpZGF0ZS9IMldBMDQxMjQvIiwiciI6IjM3MjE0NTNjLWQwMzktNDNkYS04OWY3LTdjODJlOTBhMmEwYSIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9) have not filed FEC reports according to the FEC online public archive.
