In Defense Of Our President: Winning, Not Whining | | Imagine raising a child in a house where the only conversation is an obsession with an evil, corrupt person who inflicts pain and misery on others—and this is all they hear, which means it is all they know. There is no place in this house for stories about good, hope, and a better future, only fear. How do you think that child is going to turn out? What will their view of the world be? Let in stories of good, hope, and a better future, or you will manifest your destiny and theirs. We kicked off the last week, and thank you to the many people who have responded thus far. Now more than ever, our President needs our support, and the best and easiest way we can do this is by promoting pro-Democrat and pro-Biden information. We can no longer allow the media to profit by pandering to the lowest common denominator and glorifying the Republican opponent, MAGA, and its minions. To earn our marketing dollars and respect, they need to publish news that is worthy, reflective of the good work Biden and Democrats are doing, and engage in fair and accurate reporting. We ensure they do this by withholding our attention from scandalous posts, articles, and news programs, and by directing our subscription dollars, likes, comments, and shares to what is strengthening our country and building a future where we all thrive. | | | | Everywhere we turn, we see the need for us to do better in our management of the media. Last Sunday, while on the stairmaster at the gym, I watched Fox, Fox Sunday Edition, and CNN. Fox was defending Biden against the inaccurate portrayal of him in recent social media posts. Fox Sunday Edition criticized the congressional GOP for blocking Democratic-led legislation to bring ethics standards to the Supreme Court. However, CNN was a steady drumbeat of Trump, Trump, Trump... The Lincoln Project has become well known for their defense of Democratic values, and a person wrote to me saying I should follow their media posts because they "get it right." I looked at the last ten Instagram posts of the Lincoln Project, and every one of them was about Trump, Trump, Trump. Not a good word to be had for the good being done in our great nation by Biden and our Democratic leadership. | | | | is a name you might know, and if you don't, you should look him up. He is young and was one of the strongest proponents of Democratic action among social media influencers. He's been to the White House and recently received accolades from CNN for his work with the youth vote. When he started, he was all about supporting Democrats, but when Democrats switched from promoting Biden to bashing Trump, so did he. Now his feeds are almost exclusively about Trump, with barely a mention of Biden. Not even Biden’s well-paid campaign managers can find anything good to say about him. The Biden campaign is spending $50 million to launch advertisements, like this one, about—you guessed it—Trump. The first three seconds of a video are critical, as 50% of viewers drop off, and another 50% after seven seconds. Biden doesn't appear in his own video until thirteen seconds in! | | | | It is our obligation to help turn this around. If the media remains obsessed with Trump and even the Biden Campaign is at a loss for anything good to say about Biden, then the media can reframe any story so that down is literally up, as seen in showing people believe crime is up and the economy is tanking. Sadly, those most consuming this media are Democrats because MAGA supporters are watching media that is pro-Trump and anti-Biden, which looks a lot like too much of the rest of the media right now. | | | | Pledge Silence = Death | | | | | 2\. We Have Proof: Newly Registered Voter Campaign | | Rural Americans United's Newly Registered Voter Campaign is set to launch this month reaching out to over 30,000 potential new voters. Under the excellent guidance of our steering committee, our database of Washington State voter data is built, we have a list of eager volunteers, we have lined up a union printer, contacted every Democratic party in Central and Eastern Washington with the exception of Columbia County (does anyone have contact information for Columbia County Dems?), submitted two grant requests for additional funding, and confirmed our messaging strategy. Why are we reaching out to newly registered voters? This group is largely composed of youth and new citizens. They have no voting history and will fall outside the boundaries of most campaign strategies. It is strategically imperative that we make first contact, "immunize" them against the far-right and MAGA rhetoric, develop a dialogue with them to offer an alternative and informed option, and include them in the democratic process. Our messaging strategy is not traditionally issues-based, but broader. We believe, and studies support, that the majority of this group, particularly youth, has low knowledge of issues, low interest in specific issues as a driver of their daily decisions, and will find the specificity of healthcare, education, and party politics too obtuse and unrelatable. Instead, we have approached it from a contextual perspective, relating to life events and emotions. Here is the first proof draft. Language and editing are not confirmed, but this should give a good idea of our direction. | | | | | | This project will reach over 30,000 newly registered voters in Central and Eastern Washington. Additionally, we are working with local Democratic parties and organizations to further target specific races and build support for our candidates. We need your support. These are union-printed postcards, and all the labor is volunteer, but it still costs money. | | | | | | | 3\. Granny Caravan Kicks Off To Media Fanfare | | The Granny Caravan: Unity Road Tour kicked off to much fanfare. Shirley and Roz were featured on and in local newspapers like the Newport Miner. Stopping in Deer Park and Newport, they met many people who shared their concerns. This information is being collected and will be later summarized for distribution to all candidates. It is important that our candidates hear from people in small communities they otherwise would not. Follow along on their page to see if they will be stopping in your town soon. | | | | | | | | | 4\. The Race For Congressional Districts 4 and 5 Update | | The Congressional House races for districts 4 and 5 are well underway. With less than two months until the primary, all eyes are on the candidates to see who can "bring it" and make it through to the primary. Both districts 4 and 5 are crowded with Democrats, making it an exceptional challenge for them to reach the general election. We have for Democrats in congressional district 5, and with this being an open seat, it is a once-in-a-generation opportunity that will determine whether extreme far-right politics continues to strangle rural Washington. | | _**Thank You!**_
---
| | Friends, As you may have heard, my last day as your Chairwoman will be on Monday. As someone who started at a young age, putting up yard signs and knocking on doors, It has truly been an honor to work alongside all of you to achieve all that we have in the last 10 months. Thank you for giving me the opportunity to connect with the grassroots of our party and allowing me to speak at so many of your amazing events. I want to give a special thank you to executive director Joe Elsener and the entire GOP state party team for the support they gave me during my time as chair. What we accomplished could not have been done without the hard work they put in day-in and day-out. I know each and every one of them will continue to do outstanding work to continue to elect Republicans across the state of Indiana. To be clear, this is not a goodbye. Although I will no longer be Chair of the Indiana Republican Party, I am thrilled to continue my role as National Committeewoman, representing our great state at the RNC. This transition means I am merely changing seats, not my dedication to our party. If you ever need anything, I am only an email, text, or phone call away and look forward to continuing to work alongside all of you in building the grassroots and strength of our party.
Thank you for your continued support and for all that you do.
---

---
| | Chairwoman Anne F. Hathaway

ICYMI
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=69298&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=61752> : Dahlstrom Talks Congressional Run,
Border with Alaska Landmine

ANCHORAGE, AK - In case you missed it, Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom
joined Jeff Landfield on the Alaska Landmine
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=69298&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=61752> podcast to talk about her congressional
run, her recent endorsement by President Trump, the southern border
crisis, and more.

Lt. Governor Dahlstrom, who was endorsed this week by President Trump,
also touched on her experience serving Alaskans as a state legislator
and the commissioner of the Alaska Department of Corrections.

"I will not let Alaskans down. That's why I'm serving in public office,"
Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom said on Alaska Landmine. "... I think to
be successful and to serve Alaskans, we need to be able to talk to all
Alaskans and listen to all Alaskans, whether they agree or disagree
with us. And think about what it is they're saying because, again, we
have one congressperson for all of Alaska, so that congressperson
shouldn't just represent one party."

"The Democrats are going to bring millions into the state. The
Republicans are going to bring millions into the state," Lt. Governor
Dahlstrom also said. "... The money's going to come in. It's going to
come in like crazy. This is a crucial race. It's crucial for Alaska and
for the country, and I'm going to run a clean, positive race and let
people know what I have to offer. What I'm willing to give and to serve
all Alaskans, and hopefully my past history will speak to people."

You can listen to the full interview by clicking here
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=69298&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=61752> .

| | Peter, For too many people, Pride has a decidedly different feel this year. States with far-right legislatures have waged war on saying “gay,” and fought against basic medical care and services for LGBTQ folks. And under Mike Johnson — the most anti-LGBTQ Speaker in history — those fights are being taken to the national level. **But I want those struggling this Pride Month to know that there’s hope.** The truth is, it wasn't that long ago I was just a gay kid named Eric who never really believed I'd be accepted as a TV meteorologist — let alone as a member of Congress. [](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/NGDO3qWB_gWigN_6HEfX_w~~/AAUS1gA~/RgRoWCXXP0TkaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2VzLXEyLTIwMjQ_) After my first job as a meteorologist in East Texas, I experienced discrimination and was ultimately pushed out of my job for being gay. Management was clear: **“We can’t have a gay meteorologist at channel 7, Eric.”** [](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/NGDO3qWB_gWigN_6HEfX_w~~/AAUS1gA~/RgRoWCXXP0TkaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2VzLXEyLTIwMjQ_)
_The suits have gotten an upgrade since my Texas days..._ It was a tough time, but after job searching and soul searching, I got the opportunity of a lifetime — to serve _my_ hometown of Rockford, Illinois — where I could be my true, proud self. Today, I can proudly say I’m the first openly gay federal representative elected in Illinois state history! **So whether it's your 10th year celebrating openly, or your first — know that you are loved and I will fight for you every day in Congress. And just by being who you are, is history-making.** Thanks for your time and support, and Happy Pride Month! 🌈 Eric | ****[Donate](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/NGDO3qWB_gWigN_6HEfX_w~~/AAUS1gA~/RgRoWCXXP0TkaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2VzLXEyLTIwMjQ_)****

subject: Your prayers and encouragement is needed
body:

to impact the lives
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWHNSSrWNB

Dear
Friend,

I'm
grateful to connect with you today and share an opportunity to
impact the lives of our courageous missionaries serving in remote
and challenging regions around the world.

In the
farthest corners of the globe, these dedicated men, women, and
families are sacrificing their comfort, security, and personal
aspirations to bring the hope and transformative message of
salvation to those who have never heard it before. With
unwavering faith, they face incredible trials, enduring
isolation, and even risking their safety to fulfill the calling
placed upon their lives.

Yet, even
people with the strongest commitment to their missionary calling
can sometimes grow weary and feel discouraged. That's where you
come in. I firmly believe that God can use your words of
encouragement to reassure our missionaries that He is with them,
strengthening them to press on.

Would you
take a moment to write a note of encouragement to one of our
missionaries serving in the field? Your notes of encouragement
can be an instrument of hope God uses to remind them that they
are not alone as they shine the light of the gospel in the
darkest corners of the world.

Will you
help encourage a missionary serving in the field?
Your
message can be a lifeline, assuring them that their sacrifices
are seen and deeply appreciated.

To send
your note of encouragement, I invite you to fill out the secure
form in this link:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63316474:WHNSSrWNB:m:3:2627245898:D5977645487411592D9281DA0345378D:r

Thank you
for your commitment to the Great Commission. Your support and
prayers are invaluable in reaching those who have yet to
experience the life-changing power of the gospel.

We are
deeply grateful for your partnership in advancing the Kingdom of
God.

In
Christ,

Emily
Hall

body:
Today, the Supreme Court upheld the federal law that prohibits people subject to domestic violence restraining orders from possessing guns.
#

Friends -
Today, the Supreme Court upheld the federal law that prohibits people subject to domestic violence restraining orders from possessing guns. Our decades-old laws protecting survivors of domestic abuse remain intact. Even this ultra-conservative court agrees 8-1 that the Second Amendment allows commonsense gun laws.
Our federal domestic violence laws are particularly important for women in our country, who are still 21 times more likely to die from a firearm than women in other high-income countries. If the Court had struck down this law, that deadly gap would surely widen.
This decision was a long time coming. Gabby and all of us here at GIFFORDS have spent the past year rallying in support of this law to keep guns out of the hands of abusers. The only way we could do this work is through the support of people like you.

https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

“Everything, everywhere” that’s how Slate described my approach to the 2024 election. It’s true. I’m traveling the country, listening to anyone who wants to talk. That’s because I truly believe that national reconciliation and healing begin with listening. And that’s what we need to defeat Trump in November 2024.

Let me explain, but first, will you rush a split donation to me and President Biden? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/biden-2024-split?refcode=20240621-slate-biden]

DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/biden-2024-split?refcode=20240621-slate-biden]

Over the past year, I’ve been on the picket line in California, New York, Michigan, and DC. I’ve met with student protestors in Wisconsin and Arab American voters in Michigan. I stumped for the volunteer write-in campaign for Biden in New Hampshire. I’ve met with manufacturing workers in Pennsylvania, South Carolina, and Iowa. I’ve partnered with universities and tech leaders to bring new opportunities for the next generation across the Midwest.

I know America is the greatest country on earth. It’s not just our access to freedom and opportunity that makes us great, but the character of the American people. I see that every day in my travels. But I also see and hear about the struggles.

https://slate.com/news-and-politics/2024/06/ro-khanna-presidential-hopes-democrats-biden.html [https://slate.com/news-and-politics/2024/06/ro-khanna-presidential-hopes-democrats-biden.html]

READ: “This Junior Congressman Thinks He Knows How Biden Can Win. Will Anyone Listen?” [https://slate.com/news-and-politics/2024/06/ro-khanna-presidential-hopes-democrats-biden.html]

Here’s the truth: over 40 years of disastrous economic policy have hollowed out the manufacturing sector and devastated working families. For many people, life today isn’t better than it was for their parents. We need to change that.

President Biden has made incredible progress in the past three years.

* He's lowered [https://www.kff.org/policy-watch/the-facts-about-the-35-insulin-copay-cap-in-medicare/] the cost of prescription drugs;
* He's helped create [https://www.politico.com/news/2024/01/19/biden-manufacturing-factory-jobs-00136473] 800,000 new manufacturing jobs;
* He invested billions in building new factories; and
* He’s forgiven over $160 billion in student loan debt [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/student-loan-forgiveness-6-1-billion-art-institutes-who-qualifies/] for 4.6 million borrowers.

But it’s going to take more than one term to reverse 40-plus years of bad policy.

Will you show President Biden you have his back by splitting a donation between our campaigns today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/biden-2024-split?refcode=20240621-slate-biden]

Fighting to re-elect Biden isn’t just about preventing another disastrous Trump presidency. It’s about revitalizing the American Dream for future generations. It’s not the last step, it’s the first.

Thank you for your activism and all that you do.

In solidarity,
Ro

body:
Peter –

While Tuesday’s primary election did not turn out as we would have hoped, I want to express my deepest gratitude to each and every one of you who has been part of this journey. Our campaign was about more than just hope and determination. It was about our shared, unwavering commitment to advancing the Democratic values we hold dear, values that unite us and give us a common purpose.

Thanks to your support and encouragement, we raised $1.1 million dollars, knocked on thousands of doors, made over 100,000 phone calls to voters, and built a campaign to be proud of. Along the way, we earned the support of so many of you and from leaders across the Commonwealth and the nation.

I was incredibly honored to receive many amazing endorsements, including from Governor Ralph Northam, Attorney General Mark Herring, Congressman Jamie Raskin, Congresswoman Kathy Manning, Congresswoman Rosa DeLauro, over 25 current and former members of the General Assembly, numerous local and community leaders, and organizations, including Ellie Smeal’s Feminist Majority Foundation, the National Organization for Women PAC, AFSCME, and DMFI PAC. To all of them, thank you.

I ran for Congress because I believe that, now more than ever, we must fight for our rights and freedoms. Democracy is on the ballot in 2024, and it will take all of us to re-elect Joe Biden and Kamala Harris, send Tim Kaine back to the Senate, and retake our Democratic Majority in the House. On election night, I was pleased to attend the victory celebration of our VA-10 nominee, Senator Suhas Subramanyam, and to have the opportunity to personally congratulate him and pledge my support. The path to the Democratic Majority runs through Virginia, and I will continue working to keep VA-10 blue in November.

Despite unprecedented, negative false attacks – including nearly $250,000 in attack ads and mail – we ran a positive campaign that focused on the future. From day one, I campaigned on abortion access, democracy, voting rights, and gun safety – issues I believe are central to working to build a better future for our country. Supporters like you have been the backbone of this campaign. Every door knocked, every call made, every dollar donated – it all made a difference.

My fight for a better, fairer, and more just Virginia continues. Thank you for believing in this vision and for standing with me every step of the way. Let’s keep pushing forward together.

Sincerely yours,

Eileen

Friend,
It's Oliver Gonzalez, and I wanted to share a special moment with you–a picture of my dad, Congressman Vicente Gonzalez, and me! 🐶
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20240621_em_fr_b1_OG_NGP [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20240621_em_fr_b1_OG_NGP]
I love this picture because it reminds me of everything Vicente does for Texas dogs and their families.
He's a real advocate for la gente, and is always trying to help our neighborhoods be more pretty and have better infrastructure like parks for us to walk!
Right now, my dad is out and about, meeting dogs and residents across town as he continues his campaign for Texas' 34th Congressional District. He's hardly home these days as it is a very competitive race, and I really miss spending time with him. That's why I'm reaching out to ask for your support. Could you donate $25 to give him some peace of mind and let him spend some time with me? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20240621_em_fr_b1_OG_NGP&amount=25]
DONATE TODAY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20240621_em_fr_b1_OG_NGP]
You see, while I miss Vicente, I understand why he's so dedicated.
I've heard him say this is a hard race, and he's doing all he can to continue making a difference and ensure our neighborhoods have everything they need and stay pawesome🐾.
Friend, having you on his team would mean the world to him. Will you please donate to his grassroots-campaign so that he can take a break from campaigning and I can get some quality time with my dad? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20240621_em_fr_b1_OG_NGP]
SUPPORT VICENTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20240621_em_fr_b1_OG_NGP]
🐾🐾,
Oliver Gonzalez
Vicente Gonzalez, a life-long Democrat, is a candidate for Texas’ 34th U.S. Congressional District.
From humble beginnings, Vicente was raised in a military family. Through hard work and pure ganas, Vicente aimed to make something of himself. His mother stressed to him over and over again that education was the key that will open doors of opportunities. Vicente made the decision to get his life back on track by going back to school to get his GED, working and attending classes at community college, and earning his college degree alongside other military families at the Embry Riddle Aeronautical University on the Corpus Christi Naval Air Station. Vicente surpassed his and his parents' dreams when he graduated from Texas A&M School of Law, earning his Juris Doctorate degree.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20240621_em_fr_b1_OG_NGP [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20240621_em_fr_b1_OG_NGP]
While in law school, Vicente learned how government should work. Through his experience as a Congressional Intern in Washington, D.C., Vicente learned how government really works. After law school, Vicente didn’t stop learning, and continued his training in Negotiation at Harvard University School of Law.
Vicente started his business, the Law Offices of V. Gonzalez and Associates, in McAllen and married Lorena Saenz, a former teacher and administrator in Edinburg and McAllen schools. Vicente has focused his practice on fighting for a level playing field for working families wronged by corporations and insurance companies evading responsibility. Through several victories for our community, Vicente recovered millions in tax dollars for South Texas school districts after shady contractors misspent millions in bond money and put our children in physical danger.
Today, Vicente Gonzalez is fighting for our South Texas values in Congress as a member of the Committees on Financial Services and Foreign Affairs and the Select Committee on Economic Disparity and Fairness in Growth. Vicente has stood by our promise to veterans, helping constituents cut through red tape at the VA and working across the aisle to prevent the shameful deportation of our honorably discharged veterans. He’s working to lower prescription drug prices, protect the benefits and healthcare of seniors, and ensure that jobs and opportunities are there for all with the ganas to work.

name: Team Dobson
subject: Dobson: Second Quarter Update

body:
Our team has been working hard to close the second quarter of fundraising with a strong report that will lay the groundwork for victory in November. | | | | [ ](https://SRCOMM.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b15308cf5f888e47b0c8aa13d&id=1f7843332b&e=701cbbe14f)
---
| | | **_A Message from Caroleene_**
---
|
---
|
---
| Over the past two weeks, our team has been working hard to close the second quarter of fundraising with a strong report that will lay the groundwork for a victory in November.

Last week, I had the opportunity to head to Washington, D.C., to galvanize national support for our campaign. It was an honor to participate in Chairwoman Stefanik's E-PAC press conference, appear live on Fox & Friends to broadcast our message, and have productive discussions with members of the Republican delegation.

Back in Alabama, it was great to attend and speak at the Alabama General Contractors', Alabama Agriculture Council's, and the Associated Builders and Contractors' summer conferences. This week, I was blessed to have friends and supporters host two successful fundraisers to help build the momentum needed to make this seat red.

I am truly humbled and honored to have hardworking men and women across our district join me in the fight for Alabama families and the future of our country. Alabama isn't just a state — it is a choice: a choice for lower taxes, smaller government, personal freedom, and family values. That is why my priority will always be to serve the people of Alabama.

Sincerely,
Caroleene Dobson
---
|
---
| | NEW ENDORSEMENTS
---
|
---
| _**Speaker Mike Johnson Endorses Dobson for Congress**_ "Caroleene Dobson represents the new ideas and commonsense solutions we need in Congress to address the problems our nation is facing, and I am proud to endorse her campaign," Johnson said. "She is committed to conservative policies that will put our country back on track and give families in Alabama and across our nation the economic relief and sense of security they deserve."

While in D.C., I was proud to receive Speaker Johnson's endorsement. His leadership of our slim majority has been essential in holding the Biden administration accountable and protecting American families from the pitfalls of bad policy. I look forward to joining him in Washington as another conservative vote toward strengthening the House majority.
---
| [READ MORE ](https://SRCOMM.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b15308cf5f888e47b0c8aa13d&id=1591cb1065&e=701cbbe14f "READ MORE ")
---
|
---
|
---

**_POLLING UPDATE_**
New polling shows that President Joe Biden and President Donald Trump are in a statistical tie in the district, with voters favoring Republicans on pocketbook issues and public safety concerns by an overwhelming margin.

According to the[ survey,](https://SRCOMM.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b15308cf5f888e47b0c8aa13d&id=3f3335aa43&e=701cbbe14f) the economy, inflation, and crime are Biden's voters' top issues, and once voters learn about both Dobson and Figures' background and issue positions, **Dobson takes a 48%-43% lead.**

body:
---
| | | | | | [](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=fdb6e021ae504168999c43dcbf26e22c&_e=hB-6YlvPNZSVWD2K1LCZbsds3hhZtIrrSclR7ey8nnLvkVqFpgvWMgmbvPlmQyJcDwv-ILrSOy8zXg8k2pb1H_HjBPqsJ6UC5oLqgzLpL2eQik1v4Y9vB-N-92LcBpWEvFZywsK_v2-mHfyV07WZNyMDrD0a4tH1WcfL9ws8OgHO-xeIanyceK9bpeB5ia3tIxT15zQC-OJnrmzkjiSN85Nqoj3a9vryiNPIrDoi9Lno04rGdG-14s_Vx0MHvrvJpD8Lv32qSGDQHaIxqBDFtQjtC8XTSTCFS6cNXK2Yr9oJ5VSDtU2vpR6qZo3hiB7Qk3b-Qh99OT_SBUK4PWJtte2zKnK9UjaDiuj-_4R1f1ry9eC3ZExNCPSU8sOtsUk2)
Friend, with just months until voters head to the polls, Joe Biden is finally admitting his border policies have been an unmitigated disaster.

His new executive order on immigration is nothing more than an election year stunt designed to trick Americans into thinking he's serious about securing our borders.

For nearly four years, Biden has willfully dismantled every effective policy put in place by President Trump to protect our country.
[](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=fdb6e021ae504168999c43dcbf26e22c&_e=hB-6YlvPNZSVWD2K1LCZbsds3hhZtIrrSclR7ey8nnLvkVqFpgvWMgmbvPlmQyJcDwv-ILrSOy8zXg8k2pb1H_HjBPqsJ6UC5oLqgzLpL2eQik1v4Y9vB-N-92LcBpWEvFZywsK_v2-mHfyV07WZNyMDrD0a4tH1WcfL9ws8OgHO-xeIanyceK9bpeB5ia3tIxT15zQC-OJnrmzkjiSN85Nqoj3a9vryiNPIrDoi9LnkXX8Q3RqiyzimimDQhxUyX8HzSUOkDB5_GvLmWvmUzfgGrlMEj2Jf7RnMp-xIKCa9XW6E22aHEejFW4s-aAb6_wJajfhsNqWWy89WX43-UeBvWgxkWOIxOlHRwgj64OYFRgQe8aGn97atR3xOWNoO)
He opened the floodgates to record levels of illegal immigration, allowing millions to pour over our borders unchecked. Deadly drugs now flow freely into our communities, while human traffickers exploit our lax enforcement.

Now, as Americans everywhere feel the consequences of his open borders agenda, Biden hopes this 11th hour executive order will paper over his failures. He's counting on voters to fall for this cheap political ploy instead of holding him accountable for the unprecedented border crisis he created.

Dear Peter, Celebrate National Dairy Month in the 8th Congressional District, where dairy farming is a way of life. Join us in honoring our hardworking farmers and enjoying the delicious dairy products they produce. Our campaign is dedicated to promoting policies that protect and empower our agricultural sector, ensuring that our dairy farmers can continue to thrive. We believe in supporting the backbone of our district’s economy with measures that reduce regulatory burdens and promote sustainable farming practices. This National Dairy Month, we’re asking for your support. By donating to our campaign, you’re helping us champion the values and needs of our agricultural community. Your contribution will enable us to advocate for policies that ensure the success and growth of our dairy industry. | | | | | Join us in celebrating the farmers who bring fresh, nutritious dairy products to our tables every day. Your donation, whether it’s $5, $10, $25, or any amount, will make a difference in our fight to protect and support local agriculture. | | | | Cheers to the dairy industry's contributions to our community! In Congress, I look forward to supporting and representing our farmers and the industry. Thank you for your continued support and commitment to our shared values. Sincerely, Carmen Goers | | | | | | ---|--- or |

| All Hands on Deck!

Peter,

If you have two hands, you can help! Tomorrow, this Saturday, June 22, we need you, and possibly your friends, too! We will be at a location in Washington County, the geographical center of the 6th Congressional District, folding letters from 11am to 9pm.

There will be air conditioning. There will be pizza. There will be good conversations.

If you can fold papers, stuff an envelope, or put a stamp on an envelope, you are qualified. “Folding Parties” are a great chance to talk with people while you work, to get to know other people who care about our country, and to work to help a common-sense, hard-working guy get into Congress to represent YOU!

If you have one hour to help or even seven, please do! Call 240-329-2660 to sign-up to help and to get details. We really need your help, so any time would be greatly appreciated. The “All Hands on Deck” call is real. Please invite your friends to join you!!

Hope to see you tomorrow!

Peter,
The 2024 election is less than five months away. Most presidential polls are close, and the outcome is anyone’s guess.
**Unless, that is, you work for _Fox News_.**
[**We’ll tell you more about _Fox News_ ’s irresponsible coverage and how it’s creating another January 6th in a moment, but if you support COURIER’s mission to safeguard our democracy against right-wing misinformation, can you chip in $20 now?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87338283/480819160/-593472309?refcode=20240621-EM-FoxJan6&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZDFiNjNlMmQtZjgyZi1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=ka4fv7rM3Jzp4Z0O82qNzfO2LvV36kaeycL_Mgmfy2c=)
January 6th wouldn’t have been possible without _Fox News_ , Peter. Legal documents show that, despite knowing full well that Trump was lying, _Fox_ executives and personalities pushed his baseless election conspiracies to boost ratings in the days following the 2020 election.
Now, Trump is at it again. Recently, he told _Time Magazine_ that the only way Joe Biden can win is if Democrats rely on “the things that they did the last time.” In the same interview, Trump refused to rule out political violence should he lose.

body:
One thing I’ve learned is that not everyone does it like us. A lot of big national organizations will parachute in, shell out thousands of dollars for really generic-seeming ads, and call it a day.

| Peter,

I’ve been on the road helping our candidates so often lately that it’s rare I get to sleep in my own bed anymore. But each time I get the news that someone we endorsed won their election, I know it’s worth it.

Here’s a few of the places I’ve been lately:
* **Orlando, FL to support Nate Douglas.** At 23 years old, Nate would be the youngest person in the Florida legislature.

* **Atlanta, GA to support Bryce Berry.** He’s 22 years old and would be the first public school teacher ever elected to the state legislature.

* **Houston, TX to support Molly Cook.** She’s also 23 years old and is currently the youngest and most progressive member of the Texas Senate.

[_**This work is tiring, but it’s worth it to elect so many awesome young leaders — and none of it is possible without your support. Can you pitch in $10 today to help Leaders We Deserve and Fight for Progress keep electing young leaders across the country?**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/87338837/480820876/150752135?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-06-21_1&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjhmZjQ4MDk2LWY4MmYtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=xhimPo7-UtTXcJCyhW2W2CSDGh5aPEXJlCRE66FAVj4=)

**One thing I’ve learned is that not everyone does it like us.** A lot of big national organizations will parachute in, shell out thousands of dollars for really generic-seeming ads, and call it a day.

But being on the ground, meeting campaign staff, and talking directly to voters allows us to invest your donations much more effectively because we know exactly the best place to spend it.

We can identify what each campaign needs to move the needle in their races — whether that’s more doors knocked, a TV ad, a mail piece on a certain issue, or something else entirely.

**And the work is paying off, too.** Last year we elected our first endorsed candidate, **Nadarius Clark** , in Virginia. Just a couple weeks ago, **Molly Cook** won a special election to serve out the remainder of the current term in the Texas Senate — AND she just won the Democratic primary runoff _by only 74 votes!_

**Peter, I’ll always be an organizer.**

So _as_ a longtime organizer and the first Gen Z member of Congress, I know the same old tactics _won’t_ deliver a new generation of voters across Florida. We’ve gotta get creative.

That’s why my organizing team and I are traveling across Florida, meeting young people where they are: **college campuses, coffee shops, bars, parks – basically wherever we can afford to send a team!**

This type of organizing is the key to bringing politics to a new generation, who are becoming more disillusioned by the day – and who we need more than ever in this upcoming election.

My campaign is fostering a new generation of organizers, who are doing more than just shaming apathy, but inspiring hope. **_This is how we’re going to turn out a record-breaking number of young voters. This is how we’re going to flip Florida blue._**

**But without the money to hire more organizers, we won’t be able to reach the amount of voters we need to make a real impact on Election day.** [**_So I’m personally asking, Peter. Let me tell you a little bit about myself.... I'm a retired Navy CAPT who spent 25 years fighting for our country in some of the most dangerous battlegrounds in the world. My family and I came to America when I was just four years old after my father was put on a kill list in Communist Vietnam. If it wasn't for America, I probably wouldn't be alive today. I owe my life to this country - so I paid her back by attending the Naval Academy after graduating high school and dedicating my career to serving America. I served in Iraq, Afghanistan, and Somalia where I defused IEDs for our SEAL teams and Special Forces. I performed some of the most dangerous dives in the military all around the world. It wasn't easy, and there were many times where my life flashed before my eyes. But it was worth it, because I was protecting this country so the next generation could have the same opportunities that I did. Now that Democrats are trying to destroy that American Dream, I'm not about to sit by idly. Our fight isn't just overseas anymore. It's right here in America, where far-Left liberals in Washington DC are working to erode your freedom and compromise our future. I'm not a career politician. I spent my life serving our country, not serving special interests. _**[But one thing about me is I've always been called to service, and that's why I'm running for U.S. Senate in Virginia.](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=db1693c833194866b4e1a88438ebb9bb&_e=udtLuB_9VQn9I23EDBvv7VEIvK6xm8B_xFMJ2t8LNcvyBAJ2nwQsQqJyWv6ptD-A94rhFQj-_foRMvTE69Bj454lQJ7MhMWskfEQFTmOeEX0wWag-trQdOeshbtrrkn0t36pivLEbyxIrNAtCKOkrezaXTzr9dEd8v0qx_z64I4q2NvRodLqQKIBwhrJKJCIRQ1w0Wf72HuX1MPPml4JpuDl0QpS9piU9cxxKG_wpQ7ccSmJght_QVpk7y2riyCZwN6Fqw-ZCw5zhHCyi9n0Pg%3D%3D)**_

clean_body: | | | Hi, my name is Hung Cao. I just became the OFFICIAL GOP nominee for U.S. Senate in Virginia, THE battleground race that WILL decide the Senate Majority. That's why I'm reaching out to you Friend and Let me tell you a little bit about myself.... I'm a retired Navy CAPT who spent 25 years fighting for our country in some of the most dangerous battlegrounds in the world. My family and I came to America when I was just four years old after my father was put on a kill list in Communist Vietnam. If it wasn't for America, I probably wouldn't be alive today. I owe my life to this country - so I paid her back by attending the Naval Academy after graduating high school and dedicating my career to serving America. I served in Iraq, Afghanistan, and Somalia where I defused IEDs for our SEAL teams and Special Forces. I performed some of the most dangerous dives in the military all around the world. It wasn't easy, and there were many times where my life flashed before my eyes. But it was worth it, because I was protecting this country so the next generation could have the same opportunities that I did. Now that Democrats are trying to destroy that American Dream, I'm not about to sit by idly. Our fight isn't just overseas anymore. It's right here in America, where far-Left liberals in Washington DC are working to erode your freedom and compromise our future. I'm not a career politician. I spent my life serving our country, not serving special interests. NOW let me tell you who I'm up against... Remember when Hillary Clinton ran for President? Well, her hand-picked Vice-Presidential candidate, a professional politician and liberal activist named Tim Kaine is MY OPPONENT. Tim Kaine has been nothing but a pawn in the Senate for Hillary Clinton and the special interest groups since they lost to President Trump. But, he 's well-funded by the Clinton allies, and he's already coming after me with his campaign war chest. We all know running a Senate race is EXPENSIVE, and our funds have been significantly depleted from our primary battle. I'm reaching out to you today to humbly ask for your support in rebuilding our war chest for the General Election which is QUICKLY approaching. **** We have so much riding on this election, and I can't win this battle without support from patriots like you. Please stand with me today and help me restore the America we know and love. name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
subject: Alexandria’s opponent is an ex-Wall Street millionaire who is trying to buy this seat.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:

**First** , AIPAC pledged to spend $100 million against the Left to defeat our progressive movement in November.
**Then** , just before the primary election, a PAC founded by a Republican billionaire — who’s donated millions to Trump and conservative education groups — spent hundreds of thousands of dollars on billboard ads attacking Alexandria.
**Now** , Alexandria will face off against her ex-Wall Street opponent in just four days. **We need your help fighting back.**

#### The latest crackdown could be just what the neighborhood needs — if the city follows through on their commitments.
---
| Paul Davis writes about Philadelphia's Kensington Avenue, known for its open-air drug market, and the major cleanup initiative undertaken on May 8th.

Davis reached out to a former detective and asked for his take on the city government’s encampment closure that took apart the street squatter’s tents and other makeshift dwellings.

"The Kensington streets have been an eyesore, a public health issue and a national disgrace, so this kind of action was overdue and totally necessary,” he said. “And I’m glad that the city approached the cleanup not as a police action, but as a humanitarian effort..."

## About Paul Davis:
---
| |
---
Paul Davis is a South Philadelphia writer and frequent contributor to _Broad + Liberty_. He is also a regular contributor to Counterterrorism magazine, and he writes the “On Crime” column for the _Washington Times_. He enlisted in the U.S. Navy when he was 17 and served two years aboard the aircraft carrier USS Kitty Hawk during the Vietnam War. He also served two years aboard a Navy harbor tugboat at the U.S. nuclear submarine base at Holy Loch, Scotland. He performed security work as a Defense Department civilian employee after serving in the Navy, and later became a full-time writer. His work has also appeared in the _Philadelphia Inquirer_ , the _Philadelphia Daily News_ , _Philadelphia Weekly_ , and other publications.

body:
It’s Becky Edwards. Ballots have arrived and the Primary Election is in just 4 days. Turn in your ballot TODAY! | | | | | [](https://beckyforutah.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9cc818aa94e94ffd36a8547b3&id=a5f4317fa9&e=6484bb6dd5)
---
| Friend,
It’s Becky Edwards. Ballots have arrived and **the Primary Election is in just 4 days.** Turn in your ballot TODAY! They must be postmarked by end of day Monday or you can vote in-person or at an official dropbox on Tuesday.
When you are casting your ballot, please consider voting for Governing Group’s endorsed candidates in your area! Our team is supporting 17 candidates who are facing primary elections.****[**Will you chip in to help them get their message out?**](https://beckyforutah.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9cc818aa94e94ffd36a8547b3&id=63c29d86e8&e=6484bb6dd5)
These candidates are teachers, commission members and former mayors. Simply put—they are incredible people with deep ties to the communities they represent, with a steadfast commitment to solving real problems.
---
[MEET OUR CANDIDATES](https://beckyforutah.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9cc818aa94e94ffd36a8547b3&id=94a485035b&e=6484bb6dd5)
| We need your help to help these candidates get their message out. In addition to voting for these candidates, spread the word in your networks throughout Utah that each of these candidates need our support and votes!
Our focus is on providing candidates with the tools they need to succeed in these final days. [**Rush a donation of $10, $25, $100, or whatever you can afford to promote thoughtful policymaking throughout Utah.** ](https://beckyforutah.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9cc818aa94e94ffd36a8547b3&id=4c19986cc2&e=6484bb6dd5) Your financial support will go directly to helping ensure that they are successful.
Thank you for your support!
---
| Becky EdwardsFounder and Board Member, Governing Group PAC!

Please pitch in anything you can today and get your contribution supercharged by matching funds!**

name: Briana Sewell
subject: Thank you
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BRIANA SEWELL FOR CONGRESS
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/briana-sewell-email?refcode=email-header [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/briana-sewell-email?refcode=email-header] Friend, all I can say is thank you.

While the election didn’t turn out as we hoped, I am incredibly grateful for every person who was part of this team.

We gave it our all, and I am full of nothing but appreciation for each and every one of you who made our campaign possible.

Thank you to our staff, our volunteers, our donors, and our supporters. Thank you to all who knocked on doors, wrote postcards, made phone calls, and made their voice heard in this election.

On Tuesday night, I called Eugene Vindman to offer my sincere congratulations on his successful campaign. I look forward to working with Eugene to ensure we keep this seat blue and help Democrats take back the House of Representatives.

The residents of the Seventh Congressional District know what is at stake in November's election. We need a leader willing to listen and fight for our values. I look forward to supporting that process and continuing to be a voice for our community in the House of Delegates by reflecting the virtues and values of the Commonwealth we love so dearly.

Thank you for reading this message and for staying in this fight with me. The work isn’t over, and neither are we.

In tireless service,

Briana

body:
Peter, we wanted to make sure you’re up to date on what’s going on in Florida.
In April, the Florida Supreme Court ruled that an amendment to enshrine abortion rights in the Florida Constitution WILL be on the ballot this November.
Remember: Florida is currently under a near-total abortion ban. Prior to the ban, Florida was the regional savior for every person seeking an abortion in the south. If we’re able to get 60% plus one of voters to vote YES on the amendment, the near-total abortion ban is overturned, and abortion rights are RESTORED for the entire southern region of the country.
Right now, there’s an all hands on deck effort in Florida to get out the vote and get this amendment passed. That takes funding, which is why we’re coming to you. Will you split a donation of $25 or any amount with Florida Women’s Freedom Coalition and The Real Texas PAC to help restore abortion access in the south? But the SECOND the ruling came down, anti-choice zealots nationwide sprang into action to dump money into Florida in an attempt to lie to voters about what the amendment actually does.
The anti-choicers aren’t wasting a single second, Peter . So we can’t either. That’s why we’re asking: Will you split a donation of $25 or any amount with Florida Women’s Freedom Coalition and PARTNER to help protect abortion rights in Florida? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtpsupportsfwfc]
Voters will have a chance to make their voice heard this November, and we’re confident that we’re going to win. But it’s going to take a surge of nationwide grassroots support to fund the work necessary to make it happen.
Florida is the epicenter of the fight for abortion rights this November, and we need all hands on deck. Please chip in any amount you can to help us turn out the vote to guarantee abortion access in Florida. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtpsupportsfwfc]

As we go around the Fourth congressional district, one topic keeps coming up: **Housing** and **Affordable Housing**. The main topic is the affordable requirements to meet the 8-30g regulations coming from Hartford.
Many towns in the 4th District have incredible impediments to meet the requirements of 8-30g; it could potentially increase the size of the population by almost 50% that includes towns like Greenwich. Other towns like New Canaan have a land issue.

On the flip side, there are towns in the district like Bridgeport and Norwalk where there's a little more land and the area is more affordable. There is also land that can be converted from commercial to residential that can also be utilized. As a Congressman, this is something that I can work on at the federal level by potentially identifying areas to create new opportunity zones where we could really create a proper public-private partnership or in this case a federal state partnership to create a alternative to 8-30g that is actually affordable and creates a meaningful affordable housing solution.
This sector redevelopment will improve the housing and commercial landscape in areas of the Connecticut economy that are in flux. One challenge to the current Hartford mandate is that we keep hearing about workforce housing for people working where they live. This is an aspiration of Hartford and does not take into consideration the reality of working for most of us.
For most Connecticut residents in the district, many of them are commuters and picked the 4th district for the proximity to commute to New York City. These are commuters that do not live where they work so to propose a specific burden or mandate that the majority of the tax paying based does not subscribe in their own daily life is unjust. It seems incongruent with how we Americans choose where we work and where we live for the most part.

With respect to 8-30g, the focus has always been on affordable rental units. This is another issue that Hartford has not looked at correctly and needs to be addressed and tackled. The goal in this country is to create wealth and generational wealth and not simply affordable rental units.
The goal really is to looking at and support opportunities that create wealth for our future generation of new entrants to the housing market; this includes our youth that cannot afford to buy houses given the drastic increase of housing prices over the last 30 years in most of Connecticut. Getting them into homes that they own would be something that would create a wealth transfer for these individuals to pass onto their children or create an opportunity to trade up for the next house. So, 8-30g, while it is a state issue it's something that is very important to me as it creates federal consequences and opportunities.

I serve on the Greenwich RTM and the major issue that 8-30g has is the taxing of existing infrastructure that is antiquated or insufficient to meet the demands of mandated housing. This is resulting in the need for a municipality to increase capacity, especially water and sewage. In the case of Greenwich, we are upgrading and making plans to upgrade and expand pumping and sewage facilities for additional housing that may come online solely because of 8-30g. In order to meet a mandate that may result in windfall profits for a developer, the town should not subsidize certain upgrades that are needed solely because of this mandate from Hartford.
These infrastructure costs should be included to the developer's analysis so they can evaluate the profitability of such over development in these towns that are not prepared for or have the capacity to take additional sewage.
In places like Monroe the other challenge is a lack of sewer systems and the possibility of 8-30g compliant developments with self-contained sewage treatment plants. This proposes a whole other issue of environmental concerns. So, in addition to mandates on specific towns, we have towns that do not even have the resources or infrastructure to accept the types of developments that Hartford is pushing.
As a result of these mandates, it is really up to us to continue to press on and push forward against 8-30g, support organizations like CT 169 Strong and understand that there are incredible economic impacts that we are not even thinking of. In economics, they call these negative externalities that we will be paying for over the next 20 to 50 years. This is in addition to all of the increased impact and straining of our infrastructure such as I-95 and the Merritt which already are at a problem.
Unfortunately, Jim Himes has made no real advancements to our highways or our mass transit system over his career representing the fourth district. He is starting to talk about it. There have been some upgrades such as the Merritt 7 extension, but those are minor Band-Aids to help bring more to these affordable units. In towns like New Canaan, they could benefit from an upgrade to the 7 spur line with an additional rail or someway to have trains bypass to allow two way train movement on a single-line track.
Connecticut is facing probably one of its greatest infrastructure crises and anyone who travels on our roads knows they are ragged. They are some of the worst in the nation, which is unacceptable and needs to be revisited in a more methodical and thoughtful way.

These housing and infrastructure issues are one of the many reasons why I'm running for Congress as we really need some out-of-the-box and creative solutions to address the issues that we currently face with traffic and infrastructure, and to prepare for how we expand thoughtfully for the next generation.
If we can create the type of wealth that was created in Long Island from the Levitt Brothers and the development of property, such as Levittown, that would be a homerun. These low-income developments created real value for all these Long Island First time homeowners coming back from war and actually being rewarded for their service to this country through programs that created wealth.
Wealth creation is something we need drastically. We need to look at alternatives to affordable rental situations for most Americans. Rentals also prevent Americans from achieving one of the American dreams, which has always been to own your own home. The current incentives to encourage first time ownership has been something that many politicians have worked on, but in the 4th district, it is probably not enough to move the needle.

I look forward to working with state representatives and state senators and leverage the tools and resources of the federal government so that we can make sensible housing decisions for the future of Connecticut. This would also make our state more attractive as we continue to lose our tax base to other states that are more competitive and more welcoming to new ideas and businesses. It is my hope that we can create better housing solutions to attract better jobs and restore the manufacturing of this country in Connecticut that put the man on the moon and many other amazing industries.

But now that Trump's been convicted. . .well, Lawler says **he's still backing Trump** this November.

We can't say we're surprised. Lawler was a delegate for Trump in 2016 and got paid to reelect him in 2020. Lawler has proven time and again that he is just another lackey for Trump and his MAGA agenda in Congress.

_Make no mistake._ **We’re in for one of the most important fights in the history of this country—the fight to preserve democracy. And it begins right here in Wisconsin.**

Wisconsin is the tipping point state and the GOP knows it. That’s why they put their national convention in Milwaukee.

But thanks to supporters like you, we have new fair maps, more chances to flip districts from red to blue, and Democrats running in NEARLY EVERY race up and down the ballot in every part of Wisconsin. And with only 150 days till the election, we have a lot of work ahead of us.

To keep a Democratic majority in the U.S. Senate, we must reelect Tammy Baldwin, who will continue to fight for health care, clean air and water, peace and public safety, and reproductive freedom.

We must reelect President Joe Biden, who will continue to fight to bring down costs, invest in American workers, and protect voting rights—or else face the prospect of Donald Trump and his MAGA cronies deciding our elections.

_And to do all that—to elect Democrats in the Assembly, state Senate, U.S. House, U.S. Senate, and the White House..._ **we need you!**

Although the WisDems State Convention happened weeks ago, **WisDems and the GA Dems are mobilizing and _Fighting For Our Freedoms_ by prioritizing this important work —** the kind of work that will protect our elections, protect abortion rights, and help save democracy from MAGA extremism.

After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation. body:
I came to the U.S. as an undocumented child, so I understand all too well the pain of growing up in the shadows and the stress caused by the uncertainty of the situation.
# [](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/388?refcode=em20240621-9142-header&t=1&akid=9142%2E434096%2ERA0HyP)
Hey Derek, it’s Gisele.
[](https://casasanjose.salsalabs.org/casasanjosedonationpage?refcode=em20240621&amount=5)
I came to the U.S. as an undocumented child, so I understand all too well the pain of growing up in the shadows and the stress caused by the uncertainty of the situation.
Two years ago, on the 10th anniversary of DACA, I urged Congress to protect Dreamers by passing the Dream and Promise Act – which offers a path to permanent resident status. But the bill remains stalled in Congress.
Dreamers like me have gone to school, started families, paid taxes, and built businesses. Now, as DACA turns 12, all of that could be taken away.
We have to fight and advocate for a solution before it is too late. One group that has been on the frontlines is **Casa San José**.
In Pittsburgh, Casa San José is working towards a region that celebrates Latino culture, welcomes immigrants, and embraces inclusion, dignity, and respect. They are connecting, supporting, and advocating for the Latino community each and every day.
[**Will you join me in supporting the work that they do by making a $5 donation to their organization?**](https://casasanjose.salsalabs.org/casasanjosedonationpage?refcode=em20240621&amount=5)
**[Donate »](https://casasanjose.salsalabs.org/casasanjosedonationpage?amount=5&refcode=em20240621-9142)**
America is at its best when it is compassionate and welcoming. I dream of a future where everyone has opportunity. ♥️
In solidarity,
Gisele Barreto Fetterman

Growing up, I didn’t see many LGBTQ+ people in positions of power. I didn’t know if anyone was fighting for us.

When politicians talked about people like me, it was to incite bigotry or fear.

Now, those same types of politicians are targeting queer and trans kids. They’re banning gender-affirming care. They’re targeting drag shows. They’re taking books with LGBTQ+ characters off bookshelves.

**I want those kids to know that someone has their back — and I want them to know that LGBTQ+ people can and should be in the halls of power.

name: Wesley Bell
subject: We all deserve to love and live openly and freely
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BELL FOR MISSOURI
body:
Peter,

As we celebrate Pride Month, I am reminded of the power, beauty, and diversity of our LQBTQ+ communities both in St. Louis and nationwide.

Pride is a time to honor and celebrate the progress made by and for the LGBTQ+ communities and the courage it takes for LGBTQ+ individuals to live openly and authentically.

But, this month, beyond the celebrations – **I can’t help but to also think about the challenges many LGBTQ+ folks still face, especially here in Missouri**. In recent months and years, we've seen a wave of dangerous and discriminatory anti-LGBTQ+ legislation introduced by extreme legislators.

These laws aim to undermine the rights and freedoms of our LGBTQ+ friends, family members, and neighbors. They target everything from healthcare access to the ability to express one’s identity openly. This trend is not only deeply troubling, but it also threatens the fundamental principles of equality and justice that we should all stand for.

These legislative attacks are a stark reminder of the work that still lies ahead. But Peter, the majority of Americans – _which includes most St. Louisans_ – believe in a world where everyone should be allowed to live openly and freely, without fearing for their lives and safety. It's about more than just policies; it's about ensuring that every person, regardless of who they are or who they love, can lead a life filled with dignity, respect, and happiness.

We must come together to challenge these extreme lawmakers and advocate for policies that protect and uplift the LGBTQ+ community. **This means supporting inclusive education, protecting healthcare rights, and ensuring that anti-discrimination laws are not only upheld but strengthened.** So, as we celebrate Pride this month, let's also recommit to the fight for equality.

clean_body: Peter, As we celebrate Pride Month, I am reminded of the power, beauty, and diversity of our LQBTQ+ communities both in St. Louis and nationwide. Pride is a time to honor and celebrate the progress made by and for the LGBTQ+ communities and the courage it takes for LGBTQ+ individuals to live openly and authentically. But, this month, beyond the celebrations – I can’t help but to also think about the challenges many LGBTQ+ folks still face, especially here in Missouri. In recent months and years, we've seen a wave of dangerous and discriminatory anti-LGBTQ+ legislation introduced by extreme legislators. These laws aim to undermine the rights and freedoms of our LGBTQ+ friends, family members, and neighbors. They target everything from healthcare access to the ability to express one’s identity openly. This trend is not only deeply troubling, but it also threatens the fundamental principles of equality and justice that we should all stand for. These legislative attacks are a stark reminder of the work that still lies ahead. But Peter, the majority of Americans – which includes most St. Louisans – believe in a world where everyone should be allowed to live openly and freely, without fearing for their lives and safety. It's about more than just policies; it's about ensuring that every person, regardless of who they are or who they love, can lead a life filled with dignity, respect, and happiness. We must come together to challenge these extreme lawmakers and advocate for policies that protect and uplift the LGBTQ+ community. This means supporting inclusive education, protecting healthcare rights, and ensuring that anti-discrimination laws are not only upheld but strengthened. So, as we celebrate Pride this month, let's also recommit to the fight for equality. Simply put: There is no place for hate or discrimination in our state OR country. Peter, I have a quick story for you. Well, two quick stories:
When I was first running for office, a lawmaker told me that I **_couldn’t make a difference because I was “just a mom in tennis shoes.”_**
Well, this mom in tennis shoes beat the odds and won a U.S. Senate seat — part of a watershed year for women in Congress.
Decades later, a political operative told Emily Randall that **_“a queer Latina who worked for Planned Parenthood” would be “too much”_ for her swing district.**
We know how that turned out! Emily won an upset victory by 102 votes, flipped a seat from red to blue, and made history as one of the first LGBTQ+ members of the State Senate.
**The next Congress will face tough challenges. But I’m supporting Emily because she has shown time and time again that she has the grit, work ethic, and tenacity to overcome obstacles and get big things done for her community.**

| Happy Friday everyone!
I wanted to reach out as we are coming to the finish line of this 4th congressional district primary election. My campaign has gained significant momentum heading into the June 25th election day, and I am now polling in the top two of this primary race. It is also encouraging to see a large outpouring of support from the unaffiliated and swing voters. As a result, our team is extremely excited with only five days left of this election, as we see a unification of voters in our district. So, every vote counts, and I am humbly asking for your vote, your support, and your network to vote for me. Please know that if you have not voted yet, you cannot mail your ballot in at this time. You will have to drop your ballot off at a designated voting drop box or must vote in person.
After close to six months of campaigning and spending every day knocking on doors and standing in front of venues to meet as many of you as possible, I am proud to be the candidate who has taken the time to provide each one of you personal attention. I am glad that I have been able to have conversations with you regarding what concerns you and to be your voice as your next representative in Congress. Have a wonderful first summer weekend and thank you for your support!
Best regards, Peter

body:
Our elected representatives should not be validating Netanyahu and his extremist government, especially as he ignores President Biden’s red lines, continues to violate international laws, and refuses to agree to a ceasefire that would end the mass humanit | | | **Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is currently one of the world’s most wanted war criminals, Peter.** In the last month, he’s ignored the International Court of Justice’s (ICJ) order to stop his invasion of Rafah1, and has continued to _openly_ commit war crimes — including firing rounds of airstrikes on Palestinian refugee camps in areas previously designated ‘safe humanitarian zones.’2 At the same time, he’s also the target of an application for an arrest warrant being sought by the chief prosecutor at the International Criminal Court (ICC).3 And yet, despite all of this,**both Republican and Democratic leaders have decided to**** _honor_****him with an invitation to address a joint session of Congress in D.C. on July 24th.** Our elected representatives should not be validating Netanyahu and his extremist government, especially as he ignores President Biden’s red lines, continues to violate international laws, and refuses to agree to a ceasefire that would end the mass humanitarian suffering in Gaza and provide for the safe return of the Israeli hostages taken by Hamas. [**Add your name to our petition today to demand that your representatives protest Netanyahu and his extremist government at his address to Congress next month.**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoe1DuqQbjt4KoloTZxD-XRIq_Rq3KohZ4y2Iu5_arjN90KVM02Q1W4OLMdhzSzxoWvTo8SXe7yCqX9vfHUQglq9MEXXyX3oxYxpAnWHXfHEK9tG0gyav4GGnSHeloHlRwlIy7EdLG2JBf1mYiouo0e-bfW8doTAB9deKdefruZeQWnnjkRYCa6F9ipe3x0z3HHT8rdondAoRbaDuvKNkMp-d8tLoGFx9CXtpWaHf5Vbt9_JZpLRgopYUfn1uagYyQNWPxNrVYNE2EtZy5ZO41BpURi6kNQ82XWuMi-yXGKtZ-PRwZ33VQpTnCU7GTKmO1GfyRyhst0a35O15ickf9hJ2tamwcRBHvTgbKASJopSJrVbJ4ujUWX27nrLMPfo8_g/47e/U8GegrfZT0evwaA3sdpsNg/h0/h001.nMUaZ8rjcna24nJEjTPtL7gVYhQivzY_PTrmmn3q-wY) **[Sign the petition »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoe1DuqQbjt4KoloTZxD-XRIq_Rq3KohZ4y2Iu5_arjN90KVM02Q1W4OLMdhzSzxoWvTo8SXe7yCqX9vfHUQglq9MEXXyX3oxYxpAnWHXfHEK9tG0gyav4GGnSHeloHlRwlIy7EdLG2JBf1mYiouo0e-bfW8doTAB9deKdefruZeQ8oE8toEDxukSvWWT3xVg3aTvO7z-wapVk5WcuU6EbdQrsXNcOs7eIhgSwVYwTsDLxmlle0RI6IvMobLeQ16Jz_BPfIdReCRov_A5YxbWG4fgVRwlLhsFY6aI41o8QxFE0zQcG1lCMaVRl3dpIR8dp7O8cUtF61Rh9oEuJmL5JFwXHEGH0jjZzpX7RTBLq5BDdTc8UfiAmCAAm9fEeDCgrQ/47e/U8GegrfZT0evwaA3sdpsNg/h1/h001.oM6FNP8yJZTKdXLreYDB6XxSO-HEiZ6W8IlHw3rOrIw)** For over seven months, we’ve all witnessed the war crimes committed by Netanyahu’s government and the IDF and the devastation they have visited upon the Palestinian people. The airstrikes on hospitals, churches, mosques, and schools, the bombing of trapped civilians, the forced starvation, the restriction of humanitarian aid — the list goes on, and on, and on. Right now, the role of the U.S. government should be to hold Netanyahu accountable for his atrocities, and to end all offensive military aid packages to Israel — **not to**** _invite_****him to address Congress and allow him to continue undermining ceasefire negotiations and stomping all over President Biden’s red lines.** Democrats from across the ideological spectrum of the party have already said they plan to boycott Netanyahu’s address to Congress in July,4 including some of our strongest WFP champions like Sen. Elizabeth Warren, Sen. Bernie Sanders and Rep. Greg Casar. Others may choose to attend in protest. But we are calling on more members of Congress to take a stand, and send this clear message: **Inviting a war criminal currently awaiting an arrest warrant from the ICC is not the move — ending weapons shipments to Israel and doing all we can to return the hostages and set a course for lasting peace by forcing an immediate ceasefire in Gaza is.** [**Sign your name today: Demand that your representatives protest Netanyahu at his visit to Congress next month.**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoe1DuqQbjt4KoloTZxD-XRIq_Rq3KohZ4y2Iu5_arjN90KVM02Q1W4OLMdhzSzxoWvTo8SXe7yCqX9vfHUQglq9MEXXyX3oxYxpAnWHXfHEK9tG0gyav4GGnSHeloHlRwlIy7EdLG2JBf1mYiouo0e-bfW8doTAB9deKdefruZeQRJ55xRotLOlSknUsWBwZcP9T-43rJ1auxc0eTUoqN6HYnap614Y1TzisjDJur1Cn5CuyAqWJqWFdvqEmvYNVLMXS8LiueZWYRPcDNLcqqmZUngrzdHmN565DTSobkK8W0Nhal_Ul5TdK1JA1cOsTtuWs750MPYB3FZ0R4cjqd-u9g5NyNbKPD1Jmo2RLOEQTWTUTZ7ZjHJYYGS8yuYF6Kw/47e/U8GegrfZT0evwaA3sdpsNg/h2/h001.KHUYelOsTyPcDvOR2hgbrAdn3Q2wess3l6P3R3AXCAU) In solidarity, Working Families Party Sources: 1\. clean_body: Our elected representatives should not be validating Netanyahu and his extremist government, especially as he ignores President Biden’s red lines, continues to violate international laws, and refuses to agree to a ceasefire that would end the mass humanit | | | Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is currently one of the world’s most wanted war criminals, Peter. In the last month, he’s ignored the International Court of Justice’s (ICJ) order to stop his invasion of Rafah1, and has continued to openly commit war crimes — including firing rounds of airstrikes on Palestinian refugee camps in areas previously designated ‘safe humanitarian zones.’2 At the same time, he’s also the target of an application for an arrest warrant being sought by the chief prosecutor at the International Criminal Court (ICC).3 And yet, despite all of this,both Republican and Democratic leaders have decided to honorhim with an invitation to address a joint session of Congress in D.C. on July 24th. Our elected representatives should not be validating Netanyahu and his extremist government, especially as he ignores President Biden’s red lines, continues to violate international laws, and refuses to agree to a ceasefire that would end the mass humanitarian suffering in Gaza and provide for the safe return of the Israeli hostages taken by Hamas. For over seven months, we’ve all witnessed the war crimes committed by Netanyahu’s government and the IDF and the devastation they have visited upon the Palestinian people. The airstrikes on hospitals, churches, mosques, and schools, the bombing of trapped civilians, the forced starvation, the restriction of humanitarian aid — the list goes on, and on, and on. Right now, the role of the U.S. government should be to hold Netanyahu accountable for his atrocities, and to end all offensive military aid packages to Israel — not to invitehim to address Congress and allow him to continue undermining ceasefire negotiations and stomping all over President Biden’s red lines. Democrats from across the ideological spectrum of the party have already said they plan to boycott Netanyahu’s address to Congress in July,4 including some of our strongest WFP champions like Sen. Elizabeth Warren, Sen. Bernie Sanders and Rep. Greg Casar. Others may choose to attend in protest. But we are calling on more members of Congress to take a stand, and send this clear message: Inviting a war criminal currently awaiting an arrest warrant from the ICC is not the move — ending weapons shipments to Israel and doing all we can to return the hostages and set a course for lasting peace by forcing an immediate ceasefire in Gaza is. In solidarity, Working Families Party Sources: 1\. , The New York Times, May 24, 2024. 2\. , Time Magazine , June 21, 2024. 3\. , CBS News , May 21, 2024. 4\. , The Hill , June 9, 2024. Thoughts? **There’s an important U.S. Senate race happening in my home state this year that I think you need to know about. **

Let’s start at the beginning. When I first got to know Lucas, his story resonated with me. He’s a born-and-raised Missourian who knows the real value of community — helping each other out, for better or for worse.
Growing up, his parents went bankrupt from his youngest sister’s medical bills and his family survived on the support of their friends and neighbors. After getting to college on a Pell Grant, Lucas decided to join the U.S. Marine Corps to honor the community that had given his family so much. He served for 13 years, including three deployments to Iraq and Afghanistan before later being stationed at the Pentagon.
Once he left active duty, Lucas turned his focus to the corrupt politicians and corporate monopolies that dominate our economy and squeeze small businesses. He took on everyone from Big Tech and Big Ag to defense contractors and pharmaceutical companies.
**Now, Lucas is running to defeat January 6th coward Josh Hawley and take back Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat for real, everyday people. **
| | [Elect Lucas Kunce](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87349238/480857272/106945853?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4054-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMzY4ZTA5ZS0xMjMwLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Yjjb0LkcCWyu10-2CFP6parv16nq0Bcn3kuksraw12U=)

**Since he was elected to office, Josh Hawley hasn’t fought to bring even $0.01 back to our communities — but he’s had plenty of time to make money for himself. **
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87349239/480857273/106945853?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4054-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMzY4ZTA5ZS0xMjMwLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Yjjb0LkcCWyu10-2CFP6parv16nq0Bcn3kuksraw12U=)
While giant corporations strip our state of opportunity and jack up prices, Hawley is only focused on enriching himself. He’s made hundreds of thousands of dollars more than his congressional salary by selling his weird book all about “Manhood.”
**All this, while he made taxpayers cover the cost of his own lawbreaking.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87349240/480857274/106945853?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4054-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMzY4ZTA5ZS0xMjMwLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Yjjb0LkcCWyu10-2CFP6parv16nq0Bcn3kuksraw12U=)
Missouri can’t afford another six years of Hawley in the Senate, friend, and voters of all stripes seem to agree.
**_Morning Consult_ reported that Josh Hawley has the lowest approval rating of any Republican incumbent up for re-election this November.** And even Hawley’s own former mentor, Missouri’s three-term Republican U.S. Senator Jack Danforth, said supporting Hawley was _“the worst decision I’ve ever made in my life.”_

Peter, there’s a real risk that Ruben Gallego falls short in Arizona.
Not just on our progress to goal before an important FEC deadline — though we’ve fallen behind on that goal.
Not just in the results of the polls that are coming out — though a leaked NRSC poll shows Ruben falling behind Kari Lake.

clean_body: I was inspired to serve because America gave me everything. | My name is CAPT Hung Cao. I'm a retired Navy Captain who served for 25 years in Special Operations. I served on the front lines disarming explosives with seconds to spare and performed some of the most dangerous deep dives in the military. I was inspired to serve because America gave me everything. My family escaped Communist Vietnam to the United States after my father was put on the Vietcong's kill list. If it wasn't for American freedom, I probably wouldn't be here today. I answered the call to duty when I was appointed to the Naval Academy as a young man. Now, I'm answering the call of duty to Americans once again.But my new mission is a little different. I'm now the OFFICIAL GOP nominee running for the U.S. Senate in Virginia because our voters believe our country needs true conservative leaders who put service over self. I put my life on the line for our American values and freedom because I know that America is worth defending. But today, career politicians like Tim “Hillary” Kaine are eroding the very liberties my fellow troops and I risked the ultimate sacrifice for. They've lost sight of what matters and are more interested in playing political games than serving the people they're supposed to represent. I fought for this country once, taking on terrorists face to face - I'm certainly not afraid to take on establishment politicians. We need strong leaders who will put the hardworking American people before special interests and the Clinton family insiders. I've made a commitment to our country before, and now, I'm ready to make a new one as a U.S. Senator. Answer this call to duty with me and let's get America back on track.
